bukhari:6312.title: Dua on waking up
bukhari:6312.summary: On waking, the Prophet ﷺ praised Allah, who had brought him back to life after sleep.

bukhari:2353.title: Share your surplus water
bukhari:2353.summary: Do not refuse surplus water and so deprive people of pasture.

bukhari:4981.title: The miracle of revelation
bukhari:4981.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ greatest sign was the revelation, and he hoped for many followers.

bukhari:2585.title: A gift for a gift
bukhari:2585.summary: The Prophet ﷺ accepted gifts and gave gifts in return.

bukhari:820.title: A calm prayer
bukhari:820.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ bowings and his sitting between them were roughly equal in length.

bukhari:4644.title: Choose forgiveness
bukhari:4644.summary: Allah told the Prophet ﷺ to be lenient with people and to forgive.

bukhari:4023.title: Faith begins in the heart
bukhari:4023.summary: Hearing the Prophet ﷺ recite Surah at-Tur, Jubayr felt faith taking root in him.

bukhari:5664.title: On foot to the sick
bukhari:5664.summary: The Prophet ﷺ came on foot to visit a sick man.

bukhari:10.title: A Muslim keeps others safe
bukhari:10.summary: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand others are safe.

bukhari:1190.title: Prayer in the Prophet's mosque
bukhari:1190.summary: One prayer in the Prophet's ﷺ mosque is better than a thousand elsewhere, except the Sacred Mosque.

bukhari:619.title: Two light rak'ahs
bukhari:619.summary: Between the adhan and the dawn prayer, the Prophet ﷺ always prayed two light rak'ahs.

bukhari:5013.title: Surah al-Ikhlas
bukhari:5013.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that "Say: He is Allah, the One" equals a third of the Quran.

bukhari:6211.title: Gently, like glass
bukhari:6211.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked the camel driver to go slower, out of care for the women.

bukhari:5200.title: Everyone is a shepherd
bukhari:5200.summary: Each of us is responsible for those in our care: family, home and children.

bukhari:13.title: Wish for your brother
bukhari:13.summary: Faith is complete when you wish for your brother what you wish for yourself.

bukhari:444.title: Greeting the mosque
bukhari:444.summary: On entering the mosque, pray two rak'ahs before you sit down.

bukhari:1442.title: Two angels every morning
bukhari:1442.summary: Every morning an angel says: "O Allah, give in return to the one who spends."

bukhari:5033.title: Keep revising the Quran
bukhari:5033.summary: Recite the Quran constantly: it slips away faster than a camel from its tether.

bukhari:3874.title: "Very good, very good!"
bukhari:3874.summary: The Prophet ﷺ gave a girl a shirt and praised her in her native language.

bukhari:6304.title: A prayer for the Ummah
bukhari:6304.summary: The Prophet ﷺ saved his special prayer to intercede for his Ummah.

bukhari:3751.title: Kindness to the Prophet's family
bukhari:3751.summary: Abu Bakr said: honour Muhammad ﷺ by being good to his family.

muslim:549.title: Wudu and congregation
muslim:549.summary: Whoever performs wudu well and prays with the people, Allah forgives his sins.

bukhari:1393.title: Do not abuse the dead
bukhari:1393.summary: Do not speak ill of the dead: they have reached what they sent ahead.

muslim:1690.title: Surahs of the dawn sunnah
muslim:1690.summary: In the two rak'ahs before Fajr, the Prophet ﷺ recited al-Kafirun and al-Ikhlas.

bukhari:2557.title: Share with the cook
bukhari:2557.summary: If you do not seat the one who cooked at your table, at least give him a morsel.

bukhari:4961.title: Ubayy's tears
bukhari:4961.summary: Allah named Ubayy, telling the Prophet ﷺ to recite the Quran to him, and he wept with joy.

bukhari:6000.title: One part of mercy
bukhari:6000.summary: Of a hundred parts of mercy Allah sent down one, by which all creatures show mercy to each other.

bukhari:3559.title: The best have the best manners
bukhari:3559.summary: The best of people are those with the best character.

muslim:108.title: A simple path to Paradise
muslim:108.summary: Whoever prays and holds the lawful as lawful and the unlawful as unlawful will enter Paradise.

bukhari:5090.title: Choose for faith
bukhari:5090.summary: Women are married for wealth, lineage, beauty and faith; choose the one strong in faith.

muslim:1768.title: Long standing
muslim:1768.summary: The best prayer is one with long standing in recitation of the Quran.

bukhari:6270.title: Make room
bukhari:6270.summary: Do not make someone get up so you can sit; rather, make room for each other.

muslim:1747.title: Prayer of the penitent
muslim:1747.summary: The time of the duha prayer comes when the sun warms the ground.

bukhari:5027.title: Learn and teach the Quran
bukhari:5027.summary: The best of you is the one who learns the Quran and teaches it.

bukhari:42.title: Good deeds multiply
bukhari:42.summary: Every good deed of a good Muslim is recorded from ten to seven hundred times over.

muslim:4721.title: The just with Allah
muslim:4721.summary: Those just in judgement, with family and in their duties will be on pulpits of light with Allah.

bukhari:5978.title: Ties with a mother
bukhari:5978.summary: The Prophet ﷺ allowed Asma to keep ties with her mother, who had not yet accepted Islam.

muslim:159.title: "I believe, then stay upright"
muslim:159.summary: Say: "I believe in Allah," and then remain steadfast.

bukhari:5173.title: Go to the wedding
bukhari:5173.summary: If you are invited to a wedding feast, go.

bukhari:723.title: Straight rows
bukhari:723.summary: Straightening the rows is part of performing the prayer.

bukhari:3088.title: Returning in the morning
bukhari:3088.summary: Back from a journey in the morning, the Prophet ﷺ went first to the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs.

bukhari:5037.title: "He reminded me"
bukhari:5037.summary: Hearing a reciter in the mosque, the Prophet ﷺ prayed for him, as he had reminded him of verses.

bukhari:5754.title: A good omen
bukhari:5754.summary: Birds do not foretell misfortune; a good omen is a kind word.

bukhari:3336.title: Kindred souls
bukhari:3336.summary: Souls that recognise each other draw close, and those that do not drift apart.

bukhari:2896.title: Thanks to the weak
bukhari:2896.summary: People are helped and provided for because of the weak among them.

bukhari:1437.title: Reward for the whole family
bukhari:1437.summary: If a wife gives from her husband's food without harm, she, he and the keeper are all rewarded.

bukhari:5689.title: Talbina consoles
bukhari:5689.summary: Talbina soothes the heart of the sick and takes away some of the grief.

muslim:151.title: The taste of faith
muslim:151.summary: Whoever is content with Allah, Islam and Muhammad ﷺ will taste faith.

bukhari:645.title: Twenty-seven degrees
bukhari:645.summary: Prayer in congregation is twenty-seven times better than praying alone.

bukhari:574.title: The two cool prayers
bukhari:574.summary: Whoever prays the two prayers at the cool times of day will enter Paradise.

muslim:1839.title: Guard what you learn
muslim:1839.summary: One who knows the Quran is like an owner of tethered camels: tend them and they stay.

bukhari:3545.title: A few white hairs
bukhari:3545.summary: The Prophet ﷺ had only a few white hairs on his chin.

muslim:2427.title: Sufficient provision
muslim:2427.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked for his family a provision that is enough to live on.

muslim:484.title: First at the gate of Paradise
muslim:484.summary: The Prophet ﷺ will be first to knock at Paradise's gate and will have the most followers.

bukhari:173.title: The man who watered a dog
bukhari:173.summary: A man gave water to a dog dying of thirst; Allah thanked him and admitted him to Paradise.

bukhari:796.title: "Our Lord, to You be praise"
bukhari:796.summary: Whose "Rabbana laka al-hamd" coincides with the angels' words has his sins forgiven.

bukhari:6130.title: Aisha's dolls
bukhari:6130.summary: The Prophet ﷺ did not stop young Aisha from playing with dolls with her friends.

bukhari:5448.title: The believer like a palm
bukhari:5448.summary: Among trees there is one like a Muslim: the date palm.

bukhari:4083.title: A mountain that loves us
bukhari:4083.summary: Of Mount Uhud the Prophet ﷺ said: "It loves us and we love it."

bukhari:6114.title: True strength
bukhari:6114.summary: The strong one is not the one who overpowers others, but the one who controls himself in anger.

muslim:1525.title: Until sunrise
muslim:1525.summary: After the dawn prayer the Prophet ﷺ stayed in his place until sunrise and smiled at those with him.

bukhari:4995.title: The first surah learned
bukhari:4995.summary: Al-Bara learned Surah al-A'la even before the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina.

bukhari:3382.title: Noble Yusuf
bukhari:3382.summary: Yusuf was the noble son of noble fathers: Yaqub, Ishaq and Ibrahim.

bukhari:6407.title: Remembrance gives life
bukhari:6407.summary: One who remembers his Lord and one who does not are like the living and the dead.

bukhari:3250.title: A place in Paradise
bukhari:3250.summary: A whip's length of space in Paradise is better than this world and all it holds.

muslim:1084.title: Forgive all my sins
muslim:1084.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked forgiveness for all sins: small and great, open and hidden.

bukhari:5541.title: Do not strike animals' faces
bukhari:5541.summary: The Prophet ﷺ forbade striking animals on the face.

bukhari:5143.title: Be brothers
bukhari:5143.summary: Beware of suspicion, do not seek out faults, and be brothers.

muslim:2750.title: Fasting on Monday
muslim:2750.summary: Of fasting on Monday the Prophet ﷺ said: on this day I was born and received revelation.

bukhari:55.title: Spending on family is sadaqah
bukhari:55.summary: Spending on your family seeking Allah's reward counts as sadaqah.

muslim:1688.title: Better than the whole world
muslim:1688.summary: The two rak'ahs before the dawn prayer are better than this world and all it holds.

bukhari:3211.title: Angels at the door on Friday
bukhari:3211.summary: On Friday, angels at the mosque doors record those who come, in order.

bukhari:2577.title: Sadaqah and a gift
bukhari:2577.summary: Meat given to Barira as sadaqah became a gift for the Prophet ﷺ.

bukhari:4937.title: A double reward
bukhari:4937.summary: The skilled reciter is with the noble angels; one who recites with difficulty gets double reward.

bukhari:2389.title: Gold did not linger
bukhari:2389.summary: Had the Prophet ﷺ gold like Mount Uhud, he would have wanted to give it away within three days.

bukhari:3567.title: Clear speech
bukhari:3567.summary: The Prophet ﷺ spoke so distinctly that his words could be counted.

bukhari:5675.title: Dua for healing
bukhari:5675.summary: Visiting the sick, the Prophet ﷺ prayed: "Remove the harm, Lord of mankind, and heal."

muslim:1335.title: "You are Peace"
muslim:1335.summary: After prayer the Prophet ﷺ said: "O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace."

bukhari:6436.title: Allah accepts repentance
bukhari:6436.summary: Man always wants more, but Allah accepts the repentance of those who repent.

bukhari:7505.title: Think well of Allah
bukhari:7505.summary: Allah said: "I am as My servant thinks of Me."

bukhari:6102.title: The Prophet's modesty
bukhari:6102.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was more modest than a maiden behind her curtain.

bukhari:2736.title: Ninety-nine names
bukhari:2736.summary: Allah has ninety-nine names, and whoever enumerates them will enter Paradise.

muslim:6020.title: The Prophet's generosity
muslim:6020.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was so generous that his gift led a whole tribe to accept Islam.

bukhari:600.title: Waiting is prayer too
bukhari:600.summary: While you wait for the prayer, it is as if you are already in it.

bukhari:676.title: The Prophet helped at home
bukhari:676.summary: At home the Prophet ﷺ helped his family with chores, and went out when prayer time came.

bukhari:3303.title: The rooster's crow at dawn
bukhari:3303.summary: When you hear a rooster crow, ask Allah for His favour.

bukhari:5023.title: Beautiful recitation
bukhari:5023.summary: Allah listens to nothing as He listens to a prophet chanting the Quran melodiously.

bukhari:5398.title: Not reclining
bukhari:5398.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that he does not eat while reclining.

bukhari:1426.title: The best charity
bukhari:1426.summary: The best charity is given from surplus, and begin with those you support.

bukhari:3561.title: Softer than silk
bukhari:3561.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ hand was softer than silk, and his scent sweeter than any perfume.

muslim:1083.title: Closest in prostration
muslim:1083.summary: A servant is closest to his Lord in prostration, so make much dua in it.

bukhari:6405.title: "Subhanallah" a hundred times
bukhari:6405.summary: Whoever says "Subhan-Allahi wa bi-hamdihi" a hundred times a day has his sins removed.

bukhari:6361.title: A prayer for those he rebuked
bukhari:6361.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked that his rebuke bring a believer closer to Allah.

bukhari:3244.title: What no eye has seen
bukhari:3244.summary: Allah has prepared for the righteous what no eye has seen and no heart has imagined.

bukhari:2101.title: Choose a good friend
bukhari:2101.summary: A righteous friend is like a musk seller, and a bad one like a blacksmith with his bellows.

bukhari:6628.title: Turner of hearts
bukhari:6628.summary: The Prophet ﷺ would swear: "No, by the Turner of hearts!"

bukhari:56.title: Reward even for a morsel
bukhari:56.summary: All spent for Allah's sake is rewarded, even the morsel you put in your wife's mouth.

bukhari:6034.title: He never said "no"
bukhari:6034.summary: Whatever the Prophet ﷺ was asked for, he never once said "no".

muslim:1822.title: Prayer at home
muslim:1822.summary: Keep some of your prayers for home: through them Allah places good in it.

bukhari:662.title: To the mosque in the morning
bukhari:662.summary: For whoever goes to the mosque morning and evening, Allah prepares a place in Paradise each time.

bukhari:5048.title: A beautiful voice
bukhari:5048.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised Abu Musa's fine recitation, likening it to the voice of David's family.

bukhari:1432.title: Intercede for those who ask
bukhari:1432.summary: Intercede for those in need, and you will be rewarded.

bukhari:68.title: Advice without tiring
bukhari:68.summary: The Prophet ﷺ advised people only on certain days, so that they would not grow weary.

bukhari:2320.title: A tree you planted
bukhari:2320.summary: If a person, bird or animal eats from what you planted, it counts for you as sadaqah.

bukhari:5392.title: Food enough for all
bukhari:5392.summary: Food for two is enough for three, and food for three is enough for four.

bukhari:5908.title: A beautiful face
bukhari:5908.summary: The Prophet ﷺ had a beautiful face; Abu Hurayrah never saw anyone like him.

muslim:1349.title: Tasbih after prayer
muslim:1349.summary: After each prayer say "Subhanallah" and "Alhamdulillah" 33 times and "Allahu akbar" 34.

bukhari:1497.title: Dua for those who give sadaqah
bukhari:1497.summary: On receiving sadaqah, the Prophet ﷺ asked blessings for the giver's family.

bukhari:6309.title: Joy at repentance
bukhari:6309.summary: Allah rejoices at a servant's repentance more than a man who finds his lost camel.

bukhari:6133.title: A lesson not repeated
bukhari:6133.summary: A believer is not stung twice from the same hole.

bukhari:6421.title: Two lasting desires
bukhari:6421.summary: As a person ages, love of wealth and the wish for a long life grow in him.

bukhari:6098.title: The best words and way
bukhari:6098.summary: The best words are the Book of Allah, and the best way is the way of Muhammad ﷺ.

bukhari:5991.title: Keeping ties regardless
bukhari:5991.summary: The true keeper of kinship does not cut ties, even when others cut them with him.

bukhari:781.title: "Amin" with the angels
bukhari:781.summary: Whose "Amin" coincides with the angels' "Amin" has his past sins forgiven.

bukhari:6290.title: Do not whisper in pairs
bukhari:6290.summary: Two should not whisper apart from a third, so as not to upset him.

bukhari:1160.title: Rest after the Fajr sunnah
bukhari:1160.summary: After the two rak'ahs before the dawn prayer, the Prophet ﷺ lay down on his right side.

bukhari:3341.title: "Is there anyone who will heed?"
bukhari:3341.summary: The Prophet ﷺ recited the verse "Is there anyone who will heed?" in the usual way.

bukhari:652.title: He moved a branch from the road
bukhari:652.summary: A man moved a thorny branch off the road, and Allah thanked him with forgiveness.

muslim:2388.title: Surplus for good
muslim:2388.summary: Spending your surplus is better for you, and begin with those you support.

bukhari:69.title: Make things easy, give glad news
bukhari:69.summary: Make things easy, not hard; give people good news and do not drive them away.

muslim:5336.title: A home with dates
muslim:5336.summary: A household that has dates will not go hungry.

bukhari:3819.title: A house of pearl
bukhari:3819.summary: The Prophet ﷺ gave Khadijah glad news of a house of pearl in Paradise, without noise or toil.

bukhari:3534.title: The last brick
bukhari:3534.summary: The Prophet ﷺ is like the last brick completing the beautiful building of prophethood.

bukhari:6369.title: Refuge from worry and laziness
bukhari:6369.summary: The Prophet ﷺ sought refuge from worry, grief, weakness, laziness, miserliness and the burden of debt.

bukhari:6479.title: Tears of remembrance
bukhari:6479.summary: One who remembered Allah with tears in his eyes will be in His shade.

bukhari:6099.title: Allah's forbearance
bukhari:6099.summary: No one bears offence like Allah: people are insolent, yet He heals them and provides for them.

bukhari:3251.title: A tree in Paradise
bukhari:3251.summary: In Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider could travel for a hundred years.

muslim:196.title: Religion is sincerity
muslim:196.summary: Religion is sincerity to Allah, His Book, His Messenger and all Muslims.

bukhari:450.title: A house in Paradise
bukhari:450.summary: Whoever builds a mosque for Allah's sake, Allah will build him its like in Paradise.

muslim:6553.title: Visiting the sick
muslim:6553.summary: One who visits a sick brother is among the fruits of Paradise until he returns.

bukhari:1773.title: Umrah after umrah
bukhari:1773.summary: One umrah expiates sins until the next, and an accepted hajj is rewarded with Paradise.

bukhari:1169.title: Two rak'ahs before Fajr
bukhari:1169.summary: No voluntary prayer did the Prophet ﷺ keep up as constantly as the two morning rak'ahs.

bukhari:3331.title: Be kind to your wives
bukhari:3331.summary: The Prophet ﷺ twice instructed that wives be treated with kindness.

muslim:1885.title: The greatest verse
muslim:1885.summary: Ayat al-Kursi is the greatest verse in the Book of Allah.

muslim:578.title: Wudu washes away sins
muslim:578.summary: With good wudu, sins leave the body, even from under the nails.

bukhari:481.title: Believers like one building
bukhari:481.summary: Believers support one another like the parts of one solid building.

bukhari:703.title: Keep the prayer light
bukhari:703.summary: The one leading the prayer keeps it light for the weak, the sick and the elderly.

bukhari:5901.title: In a red cloak
bukhari:5901.summary: Al-Bara never saw anyone in a red cloak more handsome than the Prophet ﷺ.

muslim:843.title: Two muezzins
muslim:843.summary: The Prophet ﷺ had two muezzins: Bilal and the blind Ibn Umm Maktum.

bukhari:4906.title: Forgive the Ansar
bukhari:4906.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked Allah to forgive the Ansar and their children.

muslim:826.title: He always remembered Allah
muslim:826.summary: The Prophet ﷺ remembered Allah at all times.

bukhari:2489.title: Respect at a shared meal
bukhari:2489.summary: The Prophet ﷺ forbade taking two dates at once without your companions' permission.

bukhari:1902.title: More generous than the wind
bukhari:1902.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was the most generous of people, and in Ramadan more generous than the free wind.

bukhari:5997.title: Kissing a child
bukhari:5997.summary: The Prophet ﷺ kissed his grandson and said: "Whoever shows no mercy is shown none."

bukhari:1203.title: Tasbih in prayer
bukhari:1203.summary: To signal during prayer, men say "Subhanallah" and women clap their hands.

bukhari:6555.title: The chambers of Paradise
bukhari:6555.summary: The people of Paradise will look at the lofty chambers as we look at the stars.

muslim:646.title: Wash your hands on waking
muslim:646.summary: On waking, pour water over your hand three times before putting it into a vessel.

bukhari:1189.title: Three mosques
bukhari:1189.summary: Special journeys are made only to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque, the Prophet's Mosque and al-Aqsa.

muslim:6548.title: Loving for Allah's sake
muslim:6548.summary: Those who love one another for Allah's sake, He will shelter in His shade.

bukhari:6038.title: Not once "uff"
bukhari:6038.summary: In ten years of service, Anas never once heard a reproach from the Prophet ﷺ.

bukhari:3735.title: "Love them, for I love them"
bukhari:3735.summary: The Prophet ﷺ sat Usama and al-Hasan with him and asked Allah to love them.

muslim:1892.title: Two protecting surahs
muslim:1892.summary: Matchless verses were revealed to the Prophet ﷺ: the surahs al-Falaq and an-Nas.

muslim:6932.title: Praise for food and drink
muslim:6932.summary: Allah is pleased with a servant who thanks Him for food and drink.

bukhari:5855.title: Right foot first
bukhari:5855.summary: Put on sandals starting with the right foot, and take them off starting with the left.

bukhari:6011.title: Like one body
bukhari:6011.summary: In their love and compassion for each other, believers are like one body.

bukhari:3560.title: He chose the easier way
bukhari:3560.summary: Of two matters the Prophet ﷺ chose the easier if it was not sinful, and he never took revenge for himself.

bukhari:6338.title: Ask with resolve
bukhari:6338.summary: When you call on Allah, ask with certainty, without saying "if You will".

bukhari:5812.title: His favourite garment
bukhari:5812.summary: The garment the Prophet ﷺ loved to wear most was a striped Yemeni cloak.

bukhari:3469.title: Inspired Umar
bukhari:3469.summary: If there is anyone in this Ummah who is inspired with the truth, it is Umar.

bukhari:5409.title: He never criticised food
bukhari:5409.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never criticised food: if he liked it he ate, if not he left it.

muslim:912.title: A tenfold blessing
muslim:912.summary: Whoever sends blessings on the Prophet ﷺ once, Allah blesses ten times.

bukhari:2260.title: The honest keeper
bukhari:2260.summary: An honest keeper who gives what he is told to, willingly, also gives charity.

bukhari:6040.title: Love from the heavens
bukhari:6040.summary: Whom Allah loves, Jibril and the dwellers of heaven love, and people on earth accept him.

bukhari:528.title: A river at your door
bukhari:528.summary: The five prayers are like a river at your door you bathe in five times a day: Allah washes away sins with them.

bukhari:1923.title: The blessing of suhur
bukhari:1923.summary: Eat before dawn, for there is blessing in suhur.

bukhari:6179.title: Do not say "I am wicked"
bukhari:6179.summary: Do not say of yourself "I am wicked"; better to say gently: "I deserve blame."

bukhari:9.title: Modesty is part of faith
bukhari:9.summary: Faith has over sixty branches, and modesty is one of them.

bukhari:12.title: Feed and greet
bukhari:12.summary: The best in Islam is to feed people and greet those you know and those you do not.

bukhari:6116.title: "Do not get angry"
bukhari:6116.summary: Asked for advice, the Prophet ﷺ repeated several times: "Do not get angry."

bukhari:5989.title: Ties of kinship and the Merciful
bukhari:5989.summary: Allah will keep ties with the one who keeps the ties of kinship.

bukhari:3758.title: Learn from the experts
bukhari:3758.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said to learn the Quran from four Companions, beginning with Ibn Mas'ud.

bukhari:94.title: Salam three times
bukhari:94.summary: The Prophet ﷺ greeted three times and repeated important things three times.

muslim:2426.title: Content with what is given
muslim:2426.summary: Successful is the one who has accepted Islam, has enough and is content with what Allah gave.

bukhari:2087.title: Oaths remove blessing
bukhari:2087.summary: An oath helps sell goods but removes the blessing from trade.

muslim:592.title: The Prophet's siwak
muslim:592.summary: Abu Musa saw the Prophet ﷺ with a siwak on his tongue.

bukhari:6341.title: Hands raised in dua
bukhari:6341.summary: The Prophet ﷺ raised his hands in dua so high that the whiteness of his armpits showed.

bukhari:3790.title: The best families of the Ansar
bukhari:3790.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised the best families of the Ansar.

bukhari:5440.title: Dates with cucumbers
bukhari:5440.summary: The Prophet ﷺ ate fresh dates with cucumbers.

bukhari:3442.title: The prophets are brothers
bukhari:3442.summary: The prophets are like brothers, and the Prophet ﷺ is closest of all to Isa, son of Maryam.

bukhari:6406.title: Two light phrases
bukhari:6406.summary: Two phrases light on the tongue are heavy on the Scales and beloved to the Most Merciful.

bukhari:1933.title: If you forgot and ate
bukhari:1933.summary: Whoever eats out of forgetfulness while fasting keeps fasting: it was Allah who fed him.

bukhari:1429.title: The giving hand is better
bukhari:1429.summary: The upper, giving hand is better than the lower, asking hand.

bukhari:3629.title: Peacemaker
bukhari:3629.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said of al-Hasan that through him Allah may reconcile two groups.

bukhari:7411.title: Allah's hand is full
bukhari:7411.summary: Spending day and night does not diminish what is in Allah's hand.

muslim:6843.title: A hundred morning and evening
muslim:6843.summary: The best one can bring is "Subhan-Allahi wa bi-hamdihi" a hundred times morning and evening.

bukhari:1195.title: A garden of Paradise
bukhari:1195.summary: Between the Prophet's ﷺ house and his pulpit lies one of the gardens of Paradise.

bukhari:2568.title: Accept invitations
bukhari:2568.summary: The Prophet ﷺ accepted both invitations and gifts, even if only a sheep's leg.

bukhari:624.title: Prayer between adhan and iqamah
bukhari:624.summary: Between every two calls there is a prayer for whoever wishes.

bukhari:3653.title: Allah is their third
bukhari:3653.summary: In the cave the Prophet ﷺ calmed Abu Bakr with words about two whose third is Allah.

bukhari:2067.title: Kinship lengthens life
bukhari:2067.summary: Whoever wants greater provision and a long life, let him keep ties of kinship.

bukhari:3417.title: Dawud's easy recitation
bukhari:3417.summary: Reciting the Psalms was made easy for Dawud, and he ate only what his own hands earned.

bukhari:3116.title: Understanding the religion
bukhari:3116.summary: When Allah wants good for someone, He gives him understanding of the religion.

bukhari:1032.title: Rain that brings benefit
bukhari:1032.summary: On seeing rain, the Prophet ﷺ would say: "May this rain be beneficial!"

bukhari:6077.title: Be first to make peace
bukhari:6077.summary: Do not shun a brother for over three days; the best is the one who greets first.

bukhari:5923.title: The finest perfume
bukhari:5923.summary: Aisha perfumed the Prophet ﷺ with the finest scents, and his hair would shine.

bukhari:3657.title: Brotherhood in Islam
bukhari:3657.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said he would take Abu Bakr as a close friend, but brotherhood in Islam is higher.

bukhari:5379.title: The Prophet loved gourd
bukhari:5379.summary: Anas came to love gourd after seeing the Prophet ﷺ pick it out.

muslim:1091.title: "Subbuhun, Quddusun"
muslim:1091.summary: In bowing and prostration the Prophet ﷺ said: "Glorified, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit."

bukhari:3549.title: Beautiful face and character
bukhari:3549.summary: The Prophet ﷺ had the most pleasant face and the finest character.

bukhari:1410.title: Half a date grows
bukhari:1410.summary: Even charity of half a date from honest earnings Allah accepts and makes grow.

bukhari:6340.title: Do not rush the answer
bukhari:6340.summary: Everyone's dua is answered as long as he is not hasty and does not say there was no answer.

bukhari:2400.title: Do not delay repaying debt
bukhari:2400.summary: It is wrong for a well-off person to delay repaying a debt.

bukhari:5649.title: Feed, visit, free
bukhari:5649.summary: Feed the hungry, visit the sick and free people from hardship.

bukhari:1182.title: Sunnah before Dhuhr and Fajr
bukhari:1182.summary: The Prophet ﷺ always prayed four rak'ahs before Dhuhr and two before Fajr.

bukhari:1974.title: Guest and family have rights
bukhari:1974.summary: Your guest and your wife have rights over you, and Dawud's fast was every other day.

bukhari:6168.title: With those you love
bukhari:6168.summary: A person will be with those he loves.

bukhari:8.title: Five pillars
bukhari:8.summary: Islam is built on five pillars: testimony, prayer, zakat, hajj and fasting.

bukhari:6129.title: "What did the little bird do?"
bukhari:6129.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was so close to people that he playfully asked a toddler about his little bird.

bukhari:908.title: Walk calmly to prayer
bukhari:908.summary: Do not run to prayer: walk calmly, pray what you catch and make up what you missed.

bukhari:7551.title: Each is eased to his path
bukhari:7551.summary: Each is eased towards what he was created for.

bukhari:2605.title: The cup and the boy
bukhari:2605.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked the boy on his right if the elders might drink first, and respected his choice.

bukhari:5971.title: Your mother
bukhari:5971.summary: Asked who most deserves kindness, the Prophet ﷺ said three times: "Your mother," then "Your father."

bukhari:7560.title: Like a sweet citron
bukhari:7560.summary: A believer who recites the Quran is like a citron, with a pleasant scent and taste.

bukhari:2072.title: Bread of your own hands
bukhari:2072.summary: The best food is what you earn by your own work; so the prophet Dawud lived.

bukhari:75.title: "O Allah, teach him the Book"
bukhari:75.summary: The Prophet ﷺ embraced Ibn Abbas and asked Allah to teach him the Book.

bukhari:6231.title: Who greets first
bukhari:6231.summary: The younger greets the elder, the walker the one sitting, the smaller group the larger.

bukhari:6490.title: Look at those below you
bukhari:6490.summary: When you see someone who has more, remember those who have less.

bukhari:3411.title: Perfect women
bukhari:3411.summary: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned the perfection of Asiya and Maryam and the excellence of Aisha.

bukhari:1957.title: Do not delay iftar
bukhari:1957.summary: People will remain in good as long as they hasten to break the fast.

bukhari:5888.title: Trimming the moustache
bukhari:5888.summary: Trimming the moustache is part of the natural disposition.

bukhari:3552.title: A face like the full moon
bukhari:3552.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ face was like the full moon.

muslim:1652.title: Dua at the mosque door
muslim:1652.summary: Entering the mosque, ask for the gates of mercy; leaving, ask for Allah's bounty.

bukhari:5352.title: Spend and you will be given
bukhari:5352.summary: Allah said: "Spend, O son of Adam, and I will spend on you."

bukhari:2603.title: Repaid with extra
bukhari:2603.summary: The Prophet ﷺ repaid Jabir his debt and gave him more besides.

muslim:6042.title: A hand in every vessel
muslim:6042.summary: After the dawn prayer the Prophet ﷺ dipped his hand in every vessel brought, even in the cold.

bukhari:6221.title: Praise when sneezing
bukhari:6221.summary: The Prophet ﷺ wished mercy on a man who sneezed and praised Allah.

bukhari:6005.title: Beside the orphan's guardian
bukhari:6005.summary: The guardian of an orphan will be beside the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise, like two adjacent fingers.

bukhari:2528.title: Thoughts are forgiven
bukhari:2528.summary: Allah forgives the Ummah what crosses the heart, unless one says or does it.

bukhari:6489.title: All but Allah is perishing
bukhari:6489.summary: The truest line of poetry: "Everything except Allah is perishing."

muslim:5883.title: Do not refuse basil
muslim:5883.summary: Do not turn down a gift of basil: it is light and smells sweet.

bukhari:445.title: Angels pray for you
bukhari:445.summary: While a person sits in his place of prayer, angels ask forgiveness and mercy for him.

bukhari:2448.title: The prayer of the wronged
bukhari:2448.summary: Beware the dua of the wronged: there is no barrier between it and Allah.

bukhari:1671.title: Without haste
bukhari:1671.summary: Piety is not in rushing; the Prophet ﷺ urged people to stay calm.

bukhari:5678.title: Every illness has a cure
bukhari:5678.summary: Whatever illness Allah sends down, He also sends down its cure.

muslim:1872.title: Three verses beat she-camels
muslim:1872.summary: Three verses recited in prayer are better than three fat she-camels.

muslim:256.title: Prayer and parents
muslim:256.summary: The best deeds are prayer on time and kindness to parents.

bukhari:2262.title: All prophets herded sheep
bukhari:2262.summary: Every prophet herded sheep, and the Prophet ﷺ too herded them for a wage.

muslim:194.title: Spread salam
muslim:194.summary: The way to mutual love is to spread the greeting of peace among yourselves.

bukhari:5458.title: Praise after eating
bukhari:5458.summary: After eating, the Prophet ﷺ praised Allah with praise abundant, good and blessed.

bukhari:2071.title: Work and cleanliness
bukhari:2071.summary: The Companions worked with their own hands and were advised to take a full bath.

bukhari:3532.title: Names of the Prophet
bukhari:3532.summary: The Prophet ﷺ named five of his names: Muhammad, Ahmad, al-Mahi, al-Hashir and al-Aqib.

bukhari:3795.title: The good of eternal life
bukhari:3795.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked Allah to improve the state of the Ansar and the Muhajirun.

bukhari:3706.title: Like Harun to Musa
bukhari:3706.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told Ali that he was to him as Harun was to Musa.

bukhari:2128.title: Measure your food
bukhari:2128.summary: Measure your food, and there will be blessing in it.

bukhari:2139.title: Do not undercut a brother
bukhari:2139.summary: Do not undercut the sale of your brother in faith.

bukhari:7434.title: Prayer before sunrise
bukhari:7434.summary: Believers will see their Lord, so do not miss the prayers before sunrise and before sunset.

muslim:2358.title: Reward morning and evening
muslim:2358.summary: Whoever lends a milch animal is rewarded both morning and evening.

bukhari:1798.title: Children on the saddle
bukhari:1798.summary: Meeting children in Mecca, the Prophet ﷺ seated one in front of him and another behind.

muslim:6847.title: Four beloved words
muslim:6847.summary: The Prophet ﷺ loved "Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu akbar" more than the whole world.

bukhari:38.title: Fasting with faith
bukhari:38.summary: Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hope of reward has his past sins forgiven.

bukhari:2692.title: The one who reconciles
bukhari:2692.summary: One who reconciles people by passing on good words is not a liar.

bukhari:3412.title: The Prophet's humility
bukhari:3412.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Let no one say that I am better than Yunus."

bukhari:707.title: Hearing a child cry
bukhari:707.summary: Hearing a child cry, the Prophet ﷺ shortened the prayer so as not to burden its mother.

bukhari:3640.title: A community upon truth
bukhari:3640.summary: People of the Prophet's ﷺ Ummah will always openly hold to the truth.

bukhari:5000.title: A scholar's humility
bukhari:5000.summary: Ibn Mas'ud learned over seventy surahs from the Prophet ﷺ, yet did not consider himself the best.

muslim:1694.title: A house for twelve rak'ahs
muslim:1694.summary: Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs in a day and night will have a house built in Paradise.

bukhari:6465.title: Consistency in small things
bukhari:6465.summary: Allah loves most the deeds done constantly, even if they are few.

bukhari:3434.title: Kindness to children
bukhari:3434.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised Quraysh women for kindness to children and care of their husbands' property.

bukhari:5049.title: Listen to another's recitation
bukhari:5049.summary: The Prophet ﷺ loved to listen to the Quran recited by others.

bukhari:5640.title: Even the prick of a thorn
bukhari:5640.summary: Any hardship of a Muslim, even the prick of a thorn, expiates his sins.

bukhari:6302.title: A house built by hand
bukhari:6302.summary: Ibn Umar built himself a house with his own hands against rain and sun.

bukhari:3820.title: Salam to Khadijah
bukhari:3820.summary: Jibril asked that Khadijah be given greetings from her Lord and glad news of Paradise.

bukhari:6412.title: Health and free time
bukhari:6412.summary: Many people fail to value two blessings: health and free time.

bukhari:6014.title: The neighbour's rights
bukhari:6014.summary: Jibril urged so much about the neighbour that the Prophet ﷺ thought he would make him an heir.

bukhari:5385.title: The Prophet's simple food
bukhari:5385.summary: All his life the Prophet ﷺ ate neither fine flatbread nor whole roasted lamb.

bukhari:887.title: Siwak before prayer
bukhari:887.summary: Were it not hard on people, the Prophet ﷺ would have ordered siwak before every prayer.

bukhari:5294.title: An hour on Friday
bukhari:5294.summary: On Friday there is a short hour when Allah grants one praying the good he asks for.

muslim:1976.title: The best day of the week
muslim:1976.summary: The best day on which the sun rises is Friday.

bukhari:5456.title: Do not leave the blessing
bukhari:5456.summary: After eating, do not wipe your hand until you have licked it.

bukhari:7255.title: The trustworthy one of the Ummah
bukhari:7255.summary: The Prophet ﷺ called Abu Ubaydah the most trustworthy man of this Ummah.

bukhari:3480.title: A lenient lender
bukhari:3480.summary: A man eased things for his debtors, and Allah was lenient with him.

bukhari:2442.title: Helping a brother in need
bukhari:2442.summary: Whoever helps his brother in need, Allah will help him in his need.

bukhari:7536.title: Allah runs to meet you
bukhari:7536.summary: If a servant comes to Allah walking, Allah hastens to meet him.

muslim:343.title: "I believe in Allah"
muslim:343.summary: If nagging doubts come, let a person say: "I believe in Allah."

muslim:1068.title: Praise filling the heavens
muslim:1068.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised Allah with praise filling the heavens and the earth.

muslim:1995.title: Two sermons
muslim:1995.summary: In the Friday sermons the Prophet ﷺ recited the Quran and counselled the people.

bukhari:127.title: Speak clearly
bukhari:127.summary: Speak to people in a way they understand.

bukhari:3257.title: The gate of ar-Rayyan
bukhari:3257.summary: Paradise has eight gates, and those who fasted will enter by the gate of ar-Rayyan.

muslim:6592.title: Sadaqah does not reduce
muslim:6592.summary: Charity does not reduce wealth, forgiving raises one up, and Allah elevates the humble.

bukhari:1947.title: No blame on the road
bukhari:1947.summary: On journeys, the fasting did not blame those not fasting, nor they the fasting.

bukhari:6078.title: He knew her mood
bukhari:6078.summary: From Aisha's words the Prophet ﷺ knew whether she was pleased or upset.

bukhari:3785.title: The most beloved people
bukhari:3785.summary: Seeing Ansar returning from a wedding, the Prophet ﷺ said they were among the people dearest to him.

muslim:1500.title: The best-natured of all
muslim:1500.summary: The Prophet ﷺ had the best character and prayed with Anas's family at home on a simple mat.

bukhari:5054.title: The Quran in a month
bukhari:5054.summary: The Prophet ﷺ advised completing the Quran in a month, and if able, in no less than seven days.

bukhari:2335.title: Land brought to life
bukhari:2335.summary: Whoever cultivates land that belongs to no one has the right to own it.

muslim:6543.title: Allah looks at hearts
muslim:6543.summary: Allah looks not at appearance and wealth, but at hearts and deeds.

bukhari:5645.title: Trial is a sign of good
bukhari:5645.summary: When Allah wants good for someone, He sends him trials.

bukhari:6018.title: Neighbour, guest and word
bukhari:6018.summary: A believer does not harm his neighbour, honours his guest, and speaks good or stays silent.

bukhari:6263.title: The handshake
bukhari:6263.summary: The Companions of the Prophet ﷺ shook hands with one another.

bukhari:2130.title: Bless their measures
bukhari:2130.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked Allah to bless the measures of the people of Medina.

bukhari:6471.title: A grateful servant
bukhari:6471.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed until his feet swelled, saying: "Should I not be a grateful servant?"

bukhari:3815.title: The best women
bukhari:3815.summary: The best woman of her time was Maryam, and the best of this Ummah is Khadijah.

muslim:590.title: Siwak at the threshold
muslim:590.summary: On entering his home, the Prophet ﷺ first used the siwak.

bukhari:5445.title: Ajwa dates in the morning
bukhari:5445.summary: Whoever eats seven ajwa dates in the morning will not be harmed that day by poison or magic.

bukhari:5905.title: The Prophet's hair
bukhari:5905.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ hair was wavy and reached below his earlobes.

muslim:6964.title: Allah loves to forgive
muslim:6964.summary: If people did not sin, Allah would bring others in order to forgive them.

bukhari:2444.title: Help your brother
bukhari:2444.summary: Help your brother when he is wronged and when he wrongs others, by holding him back from evil.

muslim:5287.title: Drink in three sips
muslim:5287.summary: The Prophet ﷺ drank in three breaths, saying it is more wholesome and pleasant.

bukhari:7352.title: Reward for effort
bukhari:7352.summary: A judge who strives earns a reward even if he errs.

muslim:6804.title: Calling to good
muslim:6804.summary: One who calls to guidance gets the reward of all who follow him.

bukhari:2993.title: Up and down with dhikr
bukhari:2993.summary: Going up, the Companions said "Allah is Greatest", going down, "Glory be to Allah".

bukhari:2891.title: Everyday sadaqah
bukhari:2891.summary: Helping a person, a kind word, every step to prayer: all of it is sadaqah.

bukhari:5467.title: Blessing a newborn
bukhari:5467.summary: The Prophet ﷺ named Abu Musa's son Ibrahim, did tahnik and blessed him.

muslim:2003.title: The golden mean
muslim:2003.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ prayers and sermons were neither too short nor too long.

bukhari:15.title: Love for the Prophet
bukhari:15.summary: Faith is complete when the Prophet ﷺ is loved more than parents, children and all people.

bukhari:1240.title: Five rights of a Muslim
bukhari:1240.summary: A Muslim returns salam, visits the sick, follows the funeral, accepts invitations and blesses one who sneezes.

bukhari:4704.title: The Mother of the Quran
bukhari:4704.summary: Surah al-Fatiha is the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Quran.

muslim:550.title: Prayers purify
muslim:550.summary: The five prayers and Friday to Friday expiate the minor sins between them.

bukhari:2076.title: Generous in trade
bukhari:2076.summary: May Allah have mercy on one who is generous when he sells, buys and asks for repayment.

bukhari:6250.title: Say your name at the door
bukhari:6250.summary: The Prophet ﷺ disliked it when someone answered "Who is it?" with just "Me".

bukhari:3035.title: He always smiled
bukhari:3035.summary: Whenever he met Jarir, the Prophet ﷺ smiled at him.

bukhari:1.title: All begins with intention
bukhari:1.summary: Deeds are judged by intentions, and each gets what he aimed for.

bukhari:5653.title: Patience will be rewarded
bukhari:5653.summary: Whoever patiently bears losing his two beloved, Allah will compensate with Paradise.

bukhari:2259.title: A gift to the nearest neighbour
bukhari:2259.summary: Of two neighbours, give the gift to the one whose door is closer.

bukhari:6272.title: Sitting by the Kaaba
bukhari:6272.summary: Ibn Umar saw the Prophet ﷺ sitting in the Kaaba courtyard, hugging his knees.

bukhari:1416.title: Working to give charity
bukhari:1416.summary: To give charity, the Companions carried loads at the market for a measure of grain.

bukhari:1898.title: The gates of Paradise open
bukhari:1898.summary: When Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened.

bukhari:5856.title: Both sandals
bukhari:5856.summary: Do not walk in one sandal: wear both or take both off.

bukhari:6007.title: Caring for a widow
bukhari:6007.summary: One who cares for a widow and the poor is like one striving in the path of Allah.

bukhari:6082.title: Brotherhood and a feast
bukhari:6082.summary: The Prophet ﷺ made Abdurrahman Sa'd's brother and told him to give a wedding feast, even with one sheep.

bukhari:6021.title: Every good deed is sadaqah
bukhari:6021.summary: Every good and approved deed is sadaqah.

bukhari:579.title: Before sunrise
bukhari:579.summary: Whoever prays even one rak'ah of the dawn prayer before sunrise has caught it.

bukhari:5376.title: In the name of Allah
bukhari:5376.summary: Say "Bismillah", eat with your right hand and take what is in front of you.

bukhari:2851.title: Blessing in horses
bukhari:2851.summary: Blessing is tied to the forelocks of horses.

muslim:7500.title: The wondrous believer
muslim:7500.summary: For the believer everything is good: in joy he gives thanks, in sorrow he is patient.

bukhari:6307.title: Forgiveness every day
bukhari:6307.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked Allah's forgiveness and repented more than seventy times a day.

bukhari:1193.title: Quba Mosque on Saturdays
bukhari:1193.summary: Every Saturday the Prophet ﷺ went to Quba Mosque, on foot or riding.

muslim:2012.title: Surah Qaf from the pulpit
muslim:2012.summary: A woman learned Surah Qaf from the Prophet ﷺ, who recited it every Friday.

bukhari:6334.title: Dua for Anas
bukhari:6334.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked for Anas wealth, children and blessing in all he was given.

bukhari:452.title: Keep others safe
bukhari:452.summary: Carrying arrows through a mosque or market, hold them by the points so as to hurt no one.

bukhari:1467.title: Reward for caring for children
bukhari:1467.summary: Spending on the children you raise is rewarded by Allah.

bukhari:5927.title: Fasting is for Allah
bukhari:5927.summary: Allah said that fasting is for Him and He Himself will reward it.

bukhari:706.title: Brief but beautiful
bukhari:706.summary: The Prophet ﷺ kept the congregational prayer short but performed it in the best way.

bukhari:6247.title: Salam to children
bukhari:6247.summary: Anas greeted children, as the Prophet ﷺ always did.

bukhari:2117.title: "No deception!"
bukhari:2117.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told a man who was being cheated to say in his deals: "No deception!"

bukhari:2714.title: Sincerity to everyone
bukhari:2714.summary: The Prophet ﷺ took Jarir's pledge to be sincere to every Muslim.

muslim:337.title: A good intention is recorded
muslim:337.summary: A good deed intended is recorded even if not done, and one carried out many times over.

bukhari:6092.title: He smiled
bukhari:6092.summary: The Prophet ﷺ did not laugh openly, but usually smiled.

muslim:2139.title: Patience at the start
muslim:2139.summary: Patience matters most at the very start of a calamity.

bukhari:168.title: Starting from the right
bukhari:168.summary: The Prophet ﷺ liked to start from the right: putting on shoes, combing and doing wudu.

bukhari:1476.title: The modest poor
bukhari:1476.summary: The truly needy is one too shy to ask, whose need no one guesses.

bukhari:2820.title: The best and bravest
bukhari:2820.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was the best, the bravest and the most generous of people.

bukhari:3194.title: Mercy prevails over wrath
bukhari:3194.summary: Allah wrote with Him on the Throne: "My mercy prevails over My wrath."

bukhari:1409.title: Worthy envy
bukhari:1409.summary: It is good to wish for two things: wealth spent on good, and wisdom lived by and taught.

bukhari:1471.title: Firewood better than begging
bukhari:1471.summary: It is better to work, carrying firewood on your back to sell, than to beg from people.

bukhari:794.title: Praise in bowing
bukhari:794.summary: In bowing and prostration the Prophet ﷺ said: "Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, praise be to You, forgive me."

bukhari:3719.title: The Prophet's helper
bukhari:3719.summary: Every prophet had a helper, and the Prophet's ﷺ was az-Zubayr.

bukhari:4839.title: Tranquillity from the Quran
bukhari:4839.summary: While Surah al-Kahf was recited, tranquillity descended for the Quran.

bukhari:5996.title: A granddaughter on his shoulders
bukhari:5996.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed with little Umama on his shoulders, setting her down and lifting her up.

bukhari:3036.title: "Make him firm"
bukhari:3036.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed that Allah make Jarir firm and make him a guide to the right path.

bukhari:2582.title: He never refused perfume
bukhari:2582.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never turned down perfume given to him.

bukhari:6446.title: Richness of the soul
bukhari:6446.summary: True richness is not abundance of possessions but richness of the soul.

bukhari:2566.title: Even a sheep's hoof
bukhari:2566.summary: No neighbour should belittle any gift to her neighbour, even the smallest.

bukhari:1434.title: Do not hoard good
bukhari:1434.summary: Do not be stingy; spend freely as you can, lest Allah withhold His gifts.

muslim:1659.title: Returning at duha time
muslim:1659.summary: The Prophet ﷺ returned from journeys in the morning and first prayed two rak'ahs in the mosque.

bukhari:3217.title: Salam from Jibril
bukhari:3217.summary: The Prophet ﷺ passed on Jibril's greeting to Aisha, and she returned it with peace.

muslim:523.title: Faces like the moon
muslim:523.summary: Seventy thousand of the Ummah will enter Paradise with faces like the moon.

bukhari:2114.title: An honest deal is blessed
bukhari:2114.summary: If seller and buyer are truthful and make all clear, their deal is blessed.

bukhari:1396.title: A deed leading to Paradise
bukhari:1396.summary: Worship Allah, pray, pay zakat and keep ties of kinship: this is the path to Paradise.

bukhari:1971.title: Fasting without extremes
bukhari:1971.summary: Apart from Ramadan, the Prophet ﷺ did not fast a whole month; he fasted, then did not.

bukhari:4388.title: Gentle hearts
bukhari:4388.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised the Yemenis for their gentle hearts, faith and wisdom.

bukhari:5431.title: He loved sweets and honey
bukhari:5431.summary: The Prophet ﷺ loved sweets and honey.

bukhari:611.title: Answering the muezzin
bukhari:611.summary: When you hear the adhan, repeat the muezzin's words.

muslim:6513.title: Your father's friends
muslim:6513.summary: The highest goodness is keeping ties with those your father loved.

bukhari:6064.title: Be brothers
bukhari:6064.summary: Beware of suspicion, do not envy, do not feud, and be brothers, O servants of Allah.

bukhari:4959.title: Allah said your name
bukhari:4959.summary: Learning that Allah told the Prophet ﷺ to recite a surah to him by name, Ubayy wept with joy.

bukhari:1146.title: How the Prophet ﷺ spent the night
bukhari:1146.summary: The Prophet ﷺ slept early in the night, rose to pray at its end, then lay down again until the call to prayer.

bukhari:6.title: Generosity in Ramadan
bukhari:6.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was the most generous of people, above all in Ramadan, when he met Jibril every night.

muslim:6708.title: Souls know one another
muslim:6708.summary: Souls are like assembled troops: those that know each other draw close, and the strangers part.

bukhari:871.title: Prayer at Umm Sulaym's house
bukhari:871.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at Umm Sulaym's: Anas and an orphan stood behind him, and Umm Sulaym behind them.

bukhari:6549.title: Contentment forever
bukhari:6549.summary: Allah will ask the people of Paradise if they are content, and grant them the best: His pleasure forever.

bukhari:868.title: A child crying
bukhari:868.summary: Hearing a child cry, the Prophet ﷺ shortened the prayer so as not to burden its mother.

bukhari:998.title: Witr, the last prayer
bukhari:998.summary: Let witr be the last of your night prayers.

bukhari:3557.title: The best of generations
bukhari:3557.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was sent in the best of the generations that followed one another.

muslim:492.title: A prayer for the Ummah
muslim:492.summary: The Prophet ﷺ saved his answered prayer to intercede for his Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.

bukhari:6344.title: Dua for Anas
bukhari:6344.summary: At his mother's request, the Prophet ﷺ asked Allah to increase Anas's wealth and children and bless them.

bukhari:2631.title: Forty good deeds
bukhari:2631.summary: There are forty good deeds, the best is lending a milch goat; any done hoping for reward leads to Paradise.

bukhari:729.title: Night prayer at home
bukhari:729.summary: The Prophet ﷺ stopped leading the night prayer with people, fearing it would be made obligatory for them.

bukhari:7006.title: A dream of a cup of milk
bukhari:7006.summary: The Prophet ﷺ dreamt he drank milk and gave the rest to Umar, and he interpreted it as knowledge.

bukhari:5437.title: A favourite gourd
bukhari:5437.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was served a soup and happily picked out the pieces of gourd from it.

bukhari:2994.title: Going up and coming down
bukhari:2994.summary: Climbing a hill, the Companions said "Allah is Greatest", and going down, "Glory be to Allah".

bukhari:6455.title: The family's modest table
bukhari:6455.summary: In Muhammad's ﷺ household, if they ate twice a day, one of the meals was dates.

muslim:1052.title: Brief but beautiful
muslim:1052.summary: The Prophet ﷺ kept the congregational prayer short but performed it in the best way.

bukhari:2401.title: Let him speak
bukhari:2401.summary: When a lender harshly demanded his debt, the Prophet ﷺ stopped his Companions: the one owed may speak.

bukhari:1981.title: Witr before sleep
bukhari:1981.summary: The Prophet ﷺ advised Abu Hurayrah three things, among them praying witr before sleep.

bukhari:5020.title: The fragrance of the Quran
bukhari:5020.summary: A believer who recites the Quran is like a citron: its taste is good and its scent pleasant.

bukhari:6080.title: Dua for the hosts
bukhari:6080.summary: The Prophet ﷺ ate at an Ansari home, prayed there on a mat and made dua to Allah for them.

bukhari:3547.title: The Prophet's ﷺ appearance
bukhari:3547.summary: Anas described the Prophet ﷺ: of medium height, rosy, with soft hair and almost no grey.

bukhari:3895.title: Shown in a dream
bukhari:3895.summary: The Prophet ﷺ twice saw Aisha in a dream on silk: "This is your wife", and said: "If it is from Allah, He will fulfil it."

bukhari:4878.title: Gardens of Eden
bukhari:4878.summary: In Eden are gardens of silver and of gold; nothing keeps people from seeing their Lord but the veil of majesty.

bukhari:6319.title: Three surahs before sleep
bukhari:6319.summary: Before sleep the Prophet ﷺ blew into his palms, read the last three surahs and wiped his hands over his body.

bukhari:5652.title: A woman of Paradise
bukhari:5652.summary: A sick woman chose patience for Paradise, and the Prophet ﷺ prayed that she stay covered during her fits.

muslim:1477.title: Twenty-seven degrees
muslim:1477.summary: Prayer in congregation surpasses praying alone by twenty-seven degrees.

bukhari:6070.title: I concealed your sins
bukhari:6070.summary: Allah will cover the believer, recall his sins and say: "I hid them in the world, and I forgive them today."

bukhari:5026.title: Reciting night and day
bukhari:5026.summary: Enviable is one whom Allah taught the Quran, reciting it night and day, and one who spends wealth on good.

bukhari:6035.title: The best have the best manners
bukhari:6035.summary: The best of you are those with the finest character.

bukhari:5605.title: Cover it, even with a stick
bukhari:5605.summary: Seeing an uncovered bowl of milk, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Why not cover it, even with a stick laid across?"

bukhari:3390.title: Noble son of the noble
bukhari:3390.summary: The Prophet ﷺ called Yusuf the noble son of noble Yaqub, son of Ishaq, son of Ibrahim.

bukhari:7270.title: Teach him the Book
bukhari:7270.summary: The Prophet ﷺ hugged young Ibn Abbas and prayed: "O Allah, teach him the Book!"

muslim:6554.title: Fruits of Paradise
muslim:6554.summary: One who visits the sick is as if among the fruits of Paradise.

bukhari:5755.title: A kind word
bukhari:5755.summary: The Prophet ﷺ rejected bad omens and called a kind word the best omen.

bukhari:3563.title: He never faulted food
bukhari:3563.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never faulted food: if he wanted it he ate, if not he simply left it.

bukhari:6215.title: Gazing at the night sky
bukhari:6215.summary: In the last third of the night the Prophet ﷺ sat up, looked at the sky and recited the verse on night and day.

bukhari:6013.title: Mercy to others
bukhari:6013.summary: Whoever shows no mercy will not be shown mercy.

muslim:1970.title: The hour of answer on Friday
muslim:1970.summary: On Friday there is a brief hour when Allah surely gives a Muslim at prayer the good he asks for.

bukhari:6204.title: Get up, Abu Turab
bukhari:6204.summary: Finding Ali asleep by the mosque wall, the Prophet ﷺ gently brushed dust off his back and called him Abu Turab.

bukhari:3245.title: Like the full moon
bukhari:3245.summary: The first to enter Paradise will be like the full moon, their hearts as one, without enmity or hatred.

muslim:2308.title: Spend and be repaid
muslim:2308.summary: Allah said: "Spend, O son of Adam, and I will spend on you," for His right hand is full and never runs dry.

bukhari:1135.title: Long night standing
bukhari:1135.summary: Ibn Mas'ud prayed at night with the Prophet ﷺ, who stood so long that Ibn Mas'ud wanted to sit down.

bukhari:1886.title: Love of home
bukhari:1886.summary: Returning from a journey and seeing Medina's walls, the Prophet ﷺ urged his camel on out of love for it.

bukhari:6416.title: Be like a traveller
bukhari:6416.summary: The Prophet ﷺ took Ibn Umar by the shoulder: "Be in this world as a stranger or a traveller."

muslim:616.title: Starting from the right
muslim:616.summary: In wudu, combing his hair and putting on shoes, the Prophet ﷺ liked to start from the right.

muslim:591.title: Siwak on coming home
muslim:591.summary: On coming home, the first thing the Prophet ﷺ took up was the siwak.

muslim:2014.title: Surah Qaf from the pulpit
muslim:2014.summary: A neighbour learned Surah Qaf from the Prophet's ﷺ voice: he recited it in every Friday sermon.

bukhari:3304.title: Doors with Allah's name
bukhari:3304.summary: At nightfall keep children in and shut doors mentioning Allah: Satan does not open a closed door.

muslim:1502.title: Praying as a family
muslim:1502.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed together with Anas, his mother and his aunt at their home.

bukhari:7476.title: Intercede for the one asking
bukhari:7476.summary: When someone in need came, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Intercede for him and you will be rewarded."

bukhari:465.title: Light on a dark night
bukhari:465.summary: Two Companions leaving the Prophet ﷺ on a dark night had their way lit until each reached home.

bukhari:3749.title: Grandson on his shoulder
bukhari:3749.summary: Holding al-Hasan on his shoulder, the Prophet ﷺ said: "O Allah, I love him, so love him too!"

muslim:1334.title: You are Peace
muslim:1334.summary: After prayer the Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness three times and said: "O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace."

bukhari:1131.title: The night of Dawud
bukhari:1131.summary: Allah's most beloved prayer is Dawud's: he slept half the night, prayed a third, then slept a sixth.

bukhari:24.title: Modesty is of faith
bukhari:24.summary: To a man reproaching his brother for modesty, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Leave him, modesty is part of faith."

bukhari:6669.title: Allah fed you
bukhari:6669.summary: Whoever eats out of forgetfulness while fasting should keep fasting: Allah fed him and gave him drink.

muslim:486.title: Paradise's gate opens for him
muslim:486.summary: The keeper of Paradise will tell the Prophet ﷺ: "I was ordered to open for no one before you."

bukhari:6472.title: Those who rely on their Lord
bukhari:6472.summary: Seventy thousand of the Ummah will enter Paradise without reckoning: those who rely on their Lord.

bukhari:834.title: Abu Bakr's dua
bukhari:834.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr: "O Allah, I have wronged myself much; forgive me and have mercy, You are Forgiving, Merciful."

bukhari:1136.title: Siwak on waking at night
bukhari:1136.summary: Waking for the night prayer, the Prophet ﷺ cleaned his mouth with a siwak.

bukhari:3747.title: O Allah, love them
bukhari:3747.summary: The Prophet ﷺ sat Usama and al-Hasan with him and said: "O Allah, love them, for I love them!"

bukhari:4713.title: Dawud's easy recitation
bukhari:4713.summary: Allah made reciting the Scripture easy for Dawud: he finished it while his mounts were being saddled.

bukhari:6288.title: No whispering before a third
bukhari:6288.summary: If you are three, two should not whisper together in front of the third.

bukhari:6664.title: Thoughts are forgiven
bukhari:6664.summary: Allah forgives the Ummah what comes to mind, as long as one does not act on it or say it.

muslim:1828.title: Little but constant
muslim:1828.summary: The deeds Allah loves most are the constant ones, even if they are few.

bukhari:6461.title: Up at the rooster's crow
bukhari:6461.summary: Aisha said: the Prophet ﷺ loved constant deeds and rose for night prayer on hearing the rooster.

bukhari:7497.title: Greetings to Khadijah
bukhari:7497.summary: Jibril brought Khadijah greetings from her Lord and news of a pearl house in Paradise, free of noise and toil.

bukhari:7441.title: Be patient until we meet
bukhari:7441.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told the Ansar: "Be patient until you meet Allah and His Messenger at the Pool."

bukhari:6371.title: Refuge from laziness
bukhari:6371.summary: The Prophet ﷺ often sought Allah's refuge from laziness, cowardice, decrepitude and miserliness.

bukhari:6020.title: The nearest door
bukhari:6020.summary: Aisha asked which neighbour to give to, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "The one whose door is nearest to you."

muslim:2420.title: Richness of the soul
muslim:2420.summary: True richness is not abundance of worldly goods but richness of the soul.

bukhari:1154.title: Waking at night
bukhari:1154.summary: Whoever wakes at night, remembers Allah and asks forgiveness or prays for something will be answered.

bukhari:1479.title: The modest poor
bukhari:1479.summary: Truly poor is one who lacks yet does not ask people, and they do not guess his need.

bukhari:6004.title: Loyalty to Khadijah
bukhari:6004.summary: The Prophet ﷺ often recalled Khadijah and sent meat to her friends; Allah gave her a pearl house in Paradise.

muslim:6593.title: What backbiting is
muslim:6593.summary: Backbiting is saying of your brother what he would dislike; saying something false of him is slander.

bukhari:7527.title: Recite the Quran beautifully
bukhari:7527.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said: "He is not of us who does not recite the Quran melodiously."

bukhari:77.title: A splash of water
bukhari:77.summary: Mahmud remembered all his life how, at five, the Prophet ﷺ playfully splashed water in his face.

bukhari:7016.title: A dream of Paradise silk
bukhari:7016.summary: Ibn Umar dreamt of silk carrying him anywhere in Paradise; the Prophet ﷺ said: "Abdullah is a righteous man."

bukhari:6952.title: Help your brother
bukhari:6952.summary: Help your brother even when he oppresses: holding him back from injustice is helping him.

muslim:6321.title: Bilal's steps in Paradise
muslim:6321.summary: Shown Paradise, the Prophet ﷺ saw Abu Talha's wife there and heard Bilal's footsteps.

bukhari:3910.title: The first child in Islam
bukhari:3910.summary: When newborn Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr was brought, the Prophet ﷺ chewed a date and put it in his mouth.

bukhari:72.title: A tree like a Muslim
bukhari:72.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said there is a tree like a Muslim, and it is the date palm.

bukhari:3556.title: A face like a piece of moon
bukhari:3556.summary: When the Prophet ﷺ was happy, his face lit up like a piece of the moon.

muslim:698.title: Waking in the night
muslim:698.summary: The Prophet ﷺ woke at night, relieved himself, washed his face and hands, and went back to sleep.

muslim:342.title: Unease is a sign of faith
muslim:342.summary: When Companions complained of evil whispers in their thoughts, the Prophet ﷺ said: "That is pure faith!"

bukhari:3451.title: Respite for the debtor
bukhari:3451.summary: A man recalled no good but leniency to debtors, and for it Allah admitted him to Paradise.

bukhari:6410.title: Ninety-nine names
bukhari:6410.summary: Allah has ninety-nine names; whoever memorises them will enter Paradise.

bukhari:651.title: Waiting for prayer
bukhari:651.summary: Greater is the reward of one who waits to pray with the imam than of one who prays and goes to sleep.

bukhari:2481.title: The broken dish
bukhari:2481.summary: When a wife broke a dish of food, the Prophet ﷺ calmly gathered the food, fed everyone and returned a whole dish.

muslim:1771.title: The hour of answer each night
muslim:1771.summary: Every night there is a time when Allah surely grants a Muslim the good he asks for.

bukhari:5045.title: Drawn-out recitation
bukhari:5045.summary: Anas said the Prophet ﷺ recited the Quran lengthening certain sounds.

muslim:6544.title: Forgiveness on Mondays
muslim:6544.summary: On Mondays and Thursdays Paradise's gates open and all are forgiven but those at odds, until they reconcile.

muslim:1491.title: Evening prayer in congregation
muslim:1491.summary: Praying isha in congregation is like praying half the night, and fajr in congregation like the whole night.

bukhari:6015.title: Counsel about the neighbour
bukhari:6015.summary: Jibril urged kindness to neighbours so often that the Prophet ﷺ thought a neighbour would become an heir.

bukhari:2793.title: A place in Paradise
bukhari:2793.summary: A bow's length of space in Paradise is better than all on which the sun rises and sets.

bukhari:1139.title: How much he prayed at night
bukhari:1139.summary: Aisha said the Prophet's ﷺ night prayer was seven, nine or eleven rak'ahs.

bukhari:7464.title: Ask with resolve
bukhari:7464.summary: When you call on Allah, ask resolutely and do not say "if You will", for no one can compel Him.

bukhari:3750.title: Like the Prophet ﷺ
bukhari:3750.summary: Abu Bakr carried little al-Hasan on his shoulders saying he looked like the Prophet ﷺ, and Ali laughed.

muslim:168.title: Love for the Prophet ﷺ
muslim:168.summary: Faith is not complete until the Prophet ﷺ is dearer to a person than family, wealth and all people.

bukhari:5534.title: The musk seller
bukhari:5534.summary: A righteous friend is like a musk seller: near him you will at least enjoy a pleasant scent.

bukhari:70.title: So as not to tire them
bukhari:70.summary: Ibn Mas'ud taught people only once a week, following the Prophet ﷺ, who spared his Companions boredom.

muslim:1745.title: If you overslept your recitation
muslim:1745.summary: Whoever sleeps through his night recitation and makes it up before Dhuhr, it is written as if read at night.

bukhari:3371.title: Protection for his grandsons
bukhari:3371.summary: The Prophet ﷺ sought protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn by Allah's perfect words, as Ibrahim did for his sons.

bukhari:2373.title: The dignity of work
bukhari:2373.summary: Better to gather a bundle of firewood and sell it than to ask people, who may give or refuse.

bukhari:6012.title: A tree you planted
bukhari:6012.summary: If a Muslim plants a tree and a person or animal eats from it, it counts for him as charity.

bukhari:7492.title: Two joys of the fasting
bukhari:7492.summary: The fasting have two joys, at iftar and on meeting their Lord; their breath is sweeter to Allah than musk.

bukhari:3614.title: Tranquillity over the reciter
bukhari:3614.summary: As a man recited al-Kahf a cloud enveloped him; the Prophet ﷺ said it was tranquillity descending for the Quran.

muslim:1766.title: If you fear oversleeping
muslim:1766.summary: Whoever fears not waking late at night should pray witr early; but prayer at night's end is better.

bukhari:1252.title: Patience at the grave
bukhari:1252.summary: Seeing a woman weeping at a grave, the Prophet ﷺ gently said: "Fear Allah and be patient."

bukhari:5631.title: Drinking in three breaths
bukhari:5631.summary: When the Prophet ﷺ drank from a vessel, he usually took three breaths.

bukhari:6269.title: Make more room
bukhari:6269.summary: Do not make a person get up so you can sit; rather, make room and give others space.

bukhari:1161.title: Night talks with Aisha
bukhari:1161.summary: After night prayer, if Aisha was awake the Prophet ﷺ talked with her; if she slept, he lay down.

bukhari:6281.title: The Prophet's ﷺ fragrance
bukhari:6281.summary: While the Prophet ﷺ napped, Umm Sulaym collected his sweat and mixed it with perfume.

muslim:1565.title: Resting on a journey
muslim:1565.summary: Stopping for the night on a journey, the Prophet ﷺ lay on his right side.

bukhari:6474.title: Guard your tongue
bukhari:6474.summary: Whoever guarantees what is between his jaws and between his legs, the Prophet ﷺ guarantees him Paradise.

bukhari:6579.title: The Prophet's ﷺ Pool
bukhari:6579.summary: The water of the Prophet's ﷺ Pool is whiter than milk, sweeter than musk; whoever drinks never thirsts.

bukhari:6463.title: Saved by Allah's mercy
bukhari:6463.summary: No one is saved by deeds alone, only by Allah's mercy; keep to what is right and move on step by step.

muslim:7229.title: Think well of Allah
muslim:7229.summary: Let none of you meet death except expecting only good from Allah.

bukhari:5369.title: Reward for caring for children
bukhari:5369.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told Umm Salama she would be rewarded for all she spent on her children.

bukhari:2017.title: Seek the Night of Decree
bukhari:2017.summary: Seek the Night of Decree in the odd nights of the last ten of Ramadan.

muslim:1874.title: Two radiant surahs
muslim:1874.summary: Recite the Quran, it will intercede; al-Baqarah and Al Imran will shield their reciters like two clouds.

bukhari:6616.title: Refuge from hardship
bukhari:6616.summary: Seek Allah's refuge from severe trials, dire misery, an evil fate and the gloating of enemies.

bukhari:3636.title: The splitting of the moon
bukhari:3636.summary: In the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime the moon split in two, and he said: "Bear witness."

muslim:170.title: Wish for your brother
muslim:170.summary: None truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself.

bukhari:2768.title: Never once reproached
bukhari:2768.summary: Anas served the Prophet ﷺ for years and was never asked: "Why did you do that?" or "Why not?"

bukhari:6994.title: Seeing the Prophet ﷺ in a dream
bukhari:6994.summary: Whoever sees the Prophet ﷺ in a dream has truly seen him: Satan cannot take his form.

muslim:1357.title: Twelve angels
muslim:1357.summary: When a man said "Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed", twelve angels hurried to raise his words.

bukhari:3713.title: Honour the Prophet's ﷺ family
bukhari:3713.summary: Abu Bakr urged: "Honour Muhammad ﷺ by honouring the members of his family."

muslim:2389.title: Given wholeheartedly
muslim:2389.summary: What is given wholeheartedly brings blessing, but what is begged greedily is like food that never fills.

muslim:152.title: Modesty is of faith
muslim:152.summary: Faith has over seventy branches, and modesty is one of them.

bukhari:3256.title: Chambers like stars
bukhari:3256.summary: The people of Paradise will see the high chambers like distant stars, reached by those who believed the messengers.

bukhari:6318.title: Fatimah's tasbih
bukhari:6318.summary: Instead of a servant, the Prophet ﷺ taught Ali and Fatimah to say Allahu akbar, Subhanallah and Alhamdulillah 33 times at bedtime.

bukhari:3209.title: Love from the heavens
bukhari:3209.summary: When Allah loves a servant, He has Jibril and heaven's dwellers love him, and he is welcomed on earth.

muslim:6774.title: Do not say "if only"
muslim:6774.summary: Strive for what benefits, seek Allah's help and do not say "if only"; say: "Allah decreed it."

bukhari:2591.title: Do not count
bukhari:2591.summary: Give and do not count, or Allah will count for you; do not hold back, or He will hold back too.

bukhari:7544.title: Beautiful recitation
bukhari:7544.summary: Allah listens to nothing as to a prophet with a fine voice chanting the Quran.

bukhari:6195.title: A wet nurse in Paradise
bukhari:6195.summary: When little Ibrahim died, the Prophet ﷺ said: "He has a wet nurse in Paradise."

bukhari:35.title: The Night of Decree
bukhari:35.summary: Whoever spends the Night of Decree in prayer with faith and hope of reward has past sins forgiven.

bukhari:1954.title: When night comes
bukhari:1954.summary: When night comes, day departs and the sun has set, the fasting person may break the fast.

bukhari:6191.title: A baby on his lap
bukhari:6191.summary: The Prophet ﷺ held a newborn on his lap and then named him al-Mundhir.

bukhari:2446.title: Like one building
bukhari:2446.summary: Believers are to each other like a building whose parts strengthen one another.

bukhari:6126.title: He chose the easier
bukhari:6126.summary: Of two matters the Prophet ﷺ always chose the easier if it was not a sin, and never took revenge for himself.

bukhari:3321.title: Water for a dog
bukhari:3321.summary: A sinful woman watered a dog dying of thirst, drawing water with her shoe, and her sins were forgiven.

bukhari:699.title: A night at aunt Maymuna's
bukhari:699.summary: Ibn Abbas stood to pray at night on the Prophet's ﷺ left, and he gently moved him to his right.

bukhari:2465.title: The rights of the road
bukhari:2465.summary: Those sitting by the road must lower their gaze, harm no one, return greetings and urge good.

bukhari:5965.title: Boys in the saddle
bukhari:5965.summary: Arriving in Mecca, the Prophet ﷺ seated the boys who met him, one in front and another behind.

muslim:6055.title: Fragrant sweat
muslim:6055.summary: When the Prophet ﷺ napped, Umm Sulaym gathered his sweat, for it was their finest perfume.

muslim:1891.title: The protecting surahs
muslim:1891.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said nothing like the verses of al-Falaq and an-Nas had ever been revealed.

muslim:1514.title: Steps to the mosque
muslim:1514.summary: A man far from the mosque was glad his steps both ways were recorded; the Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah has gathered it all for you."

bukhari:7043.title: Do not invent dreams
bukhari:7043.summary: Among the worst lies is telling of a dream one did not see.

bukhari:4719.title: Dua after the adhan
bukhari:4719.summary: Whoever, on hearing the call, asks for the Prophet ﷺ al-Wasilah and the praised station gains his intercession.

bukhari:6588.title: A garden of Paradise in Medina
bukhari:6588.summary: Between the Prophet's ﷺ house and his pulpit lies one of the gardens of Paradise.

muslim:2392.title: Understanding the religion
muslim:2392.summary: When Allah wills good for someone, He grants him understanding of the religion; the Prophet ﷺ distributes, Allah gives.

bukhari:2593.title: Fair to each one
bukhari:2593.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was fair to his wives, each with her day and night; Sawda gave her turn to Aisha.

muslim:551.title: Prayers erase mistakes
muslim:551.summary: The five prayers and one Friday to the next expiate the sins committed between them.

bukhari:213.title: If you grow drowsy
bukhari:213.summary: If you doze off in prayer, sleep until it passes and you understand what you recite.

bukhari:5854.title: Starting from the right
bukhari:5854.summary: The Prophet ﷺ liked to start from the right in purification, combing his hair and putting on sandals.

bukhari:28.title: Feed and greet
bukhari:28.summary: The best in Islam is to feed people and greet those you know and those you do not.

bukhari:730.title: The Prophet's ﷺ mat
bukhari:730.summary: By day the Prophet ﷺ spread a mat, by night screened himself with it to pray, and people began praying behind him.

bukhari:5642.title: Even the prick of a thorn
bukhari:5642.summary: Fatigue, illness, worry, grief, even a thorn's prick: for all of it Allah forgives a Muslim some sins.

muslim:6289.title: Gifts on Aisha's day
muslim:6289.summary: Wishing to please the Prophet ﷺ, people brought gifts on the day he was with Aisha.

bukhari:568.title: No sleep before isha
bukhari:568.summary: The Prophet ﷺ disliked sleeping before the night prayer and talking after it.

bukhari:6330.title: None can withhold what You give
bukhari:6330.summary: After prayer the Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no god but Allah… none can withhold what You give."

bukhari:5413.title: Plain bread
bukhari:5413.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never saw white bread of sifted flour; the Companions ate plain barley bread.

bukhari:5356.title: Begin with your own
bukhari:5356.summary: The best charity leaves you not destitute, and begin with those you support.

muslim:1837.title: Recitation at night
muslim:1837.summary: Hearing a Quran reciter at night, the Prophet ﷺ said: "May Allah have mercy on him! He reminded me of verses."

bukhari:41.title: Reward up to seven hundred
bukhari:41.summary: When one's Islam is good, Allah forgives past sins, multiplies good ten to 700 times, and records evil only as is.

bukhari:37.title: The nights of Ramadan
bukhari:37.summary: Whoever prays the nights of Ramadan with faith and hope of reward has past sins forgiven.

muslim:453.title: And as much again
muslim:453.summary: Even the lowest in Paradise will be told: "You have all you wished for, and as much again."

bukhari:1964.title: Out of mercy to people
bukhari:1964.summary: Out of mercy to people, the Prophet ﷺ forbade them to fast continuously without a break.

bukhari:5178.title: I accept any invitation
bukhari:5178.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said he would accept an invitation and a gift, even if just a sheep's leg.

muslim:2322.title: Spending on family
muslim:2322.summary: When a Muslim spends on his family hoping for Allah's reward, it counts for him as charity.

bukhari:6169.title: With those you love
bukhari:6169.summary: A person will be with those he loves, even if his deeds have not yet matched theirs.

muslim:1811.title: The night prayer's dua
muslim:1811.summary: Rising at night, the Prophet ﷺ began: "O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil… guide me to the truth."

bukhari:6119.title: The Prophet's ﷺ modesty
bukhari:6119.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was more modest than a maiden behind her curtain.

bukhari:39.title: Religion is easy
bukhari:39.summary: Religion is easy: keep to what is right, draw near it, rejoice, and seek Allah's help morning, evening and night.

bukhari:3432.title: The best women
bukhari:3432.summary: The Prophet ﷺ named Maryam, daughter of Imran, and Khadijah the best of women.

bukhari:2836.title: Were it not for You
bukhari:2836.summary: Carrying earth with everyone, the Prophet ﷺ repeated: "Were it not for You, we would not be guided."

bukhari:5056.title: I love to hear the Quran
bukhari:5056.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked Ibn Mas'ud to recite to him, saying he loved to hear it from others.

muslim:6749.title: All written in advance
muslim:6749.summary: Allah wrote the destinies 50,000 years before creating the heavens and earth, and His Throne was over the water.

bukhari:1150.title: Pray while you are fresh
bukhari:1150.summary: Let each pray while he is fresh, and when tired, stop and rest.

bukhari:6460.title: Provision for the family
