bukhari:6460.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed: "O Allah, provide for the family of Muhammad."

bukhari:6398.title: Forgive me everything
bukhari:6398.summary: The Prophet ﷺ often prayed: "My Lord, forgive my mistakes, my ignorance and all You know better than I."

bukhari:5460.title: Share with the cook
bukhari:5460.summary: If a servant brings your food, seat him with you or at least give him a morsel: he toiled at the fire for it.

muslim:1213.title: Granddaughter on his shoulders
muslim:1213.summary: The Prophet ﷺ led prayer carrying Umama on his shoulders, setting her down to bow and lifting her on rising.

bukhari:3490.title: The most honourable
bukhari:3490.summary: Asked who is most honourable, the Prophet ﷺ said: "The most God-fearing of them."

bukhari:2024.title: The last ten nights
bukhari:2024.summary: In the last ten nights of Ramadan the Prophet ﷺ spent the nights in worship and woke his family.

bukhari:3367.title: A mountain that loves us
bukhari:3367.summary: Of Uhud the Prophet ﷺ said: "This is a mountain that loves us and that we love."

bukhari:3216.title: Every gate of Paradise calls
bukhari:3216.summary: Whoever spent pairs of things for Allah's sake will be called by the keepers of every gate: "Enter here!"

muslim:1824.title: Al-Baqarah at home
muslim:1824.summary: Do not make homes into graveyards: Satan flees a house where Surah al-Baqarah is recited.

bukhari:5992.title: Good is never lost
bukhari:5992.summary: Hakim asked about good deeds before Islam; the Prophet ﷺ said: "You embraced Islam with all your past good."

bukhari:7404.title: Mercy stronger than wrath
bukhari:7404.summary: Allah wrote in His Book by the Throne: "My mercy prevails over My wrath."

bukhari:6296.title: Before sleep: close and cover
bukhari:6296.summary: Before sleep, put out lamps, lock doors, tie waterskins and cover vessels of food and drink.

bukhari:3083.title: Children greet the Prophet ﷺ
bukhari:3083.summary: As-Sa'ib ibn Yazid recalled going as a boy with other children to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

bukhari:2319.title: The honest keeper
bukhari:2319.summary: A faithful keeper who wholeheartedly hands over all the charity entrusted to him counts as a giver too.

muslim:447.title: Allah does not sleep
muslim:447.summary: Allah does not sleep; He apportions provision, and the day's deeds are presented to Him by night, the night's by day.

bukhari:6441.title: The giving hand is better
bukhari:6441.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told Hakim wealth is blessed for one who takes without greed, and the giving hand is better.

bukhari:2992.title: He hears and is near
bukhari:2992.summary: To those loudly invoking, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not strain; you call no deaf one. He is All-Hearing, Near."

bukhari:6990.title: Good dreams are glad tidings
bukhari:6990.summary: Of prophethood only glad tidings remain: good dreams.

bukhari:5907.title: Soft hands
bukhari:5907.summary: Anas recalled that the Prophet ﷺ had a handsome face and soft hands.

bukhari:3071.title: "Sanah!" Beautiful
bukhari:3071.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised little Umm Khalid's new shirt, let her play beside him and wished her long wear of it.

bukhari:5216.title: Evening visits
bukhari:5216.summary: After the afternoon prayer the Prophet ﷺ called on his wives and spent time with each of them.

muslim:182.title: Gentle hearts
muslim:182.summary: Of the people of Yemen the Prophet ﷺ said: their hearts are finer and gentler; faith and wisdom are theirs.

bukhari:7378.title: Allah's forbearance
bukhari:7378.summary: None is more patient with hurtful words than Allah: people ascribe a son to Him, yet He heals and provides.

bukhari:6986.title: If you have a bad dream
bukhari:6986.summary: A good dream is from Allah; after a bad one, seek Allah's refuge and spit to the left: it will not harm.

bukhari:7383.title: Refuge in His might
bukhari:7383.summary: The Prophet ﷺ often said: "I seek refuge in Your might; no god but You, who do not die, while jinn and men die."

bukhari:5180.title: The most beloved people
bukhari:5180.summary: Seeing women and children back from a wedding, the Prophet ﷺ stood and said: "You are among my dearest people!"

bukhari:6552.title: A tree in Paradise
bukhari:6552.summary: In Paradise is a tree in whose shade a rider would gallop a hundred years without crossing it.

bukhari:5061.title: Recite in harmony
bukhari:5061.summary: Recite the Quran while your hearts agree, and when you disagree, stop reciting.

bukhari:7138.title: Everyone is a shepherd
bukhari:7138.summary: Each of you is a shepherd responsible for his flock: a man for his family, a woman for her husband's home and children.

bukhari:5015.title: A third of the Quran a night
bukhari:5015.summary: Asked who could recite a third of the Quran a night, the Prophet ﷺ said "Say: He is Allah, the One" is a third.

bukhari:6402.title: "Amin" with the angels
bukhari:6402.summary: Whoever says "Amin" together with the angels has his past sins forgiven.

bukhari:3759.title: The best manners
bukhari:3759.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never spoke coarsely and often said that dearest to him is the one with the best character.

bukhari:2611.title: A gift to a young man
bukhari:2611.summary: The Prophet ﷺ bought from Umar the skittish camel Abdullah was riding and at once gave it to Abdullah.

muslim:1361.title: Go to prayer calmly
muslim:1361.summary: Walk to prayer at a normal pace, calmly; pray what you catch and make up what you missed.

bukhari:7419.title: Endless generosity
bukhari:7419.summary: Allah's right hand is full; generous giving night and day has not diminished it since creation.

bukhari:997.title: Waking her for witr
bukhari:997.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at night and woke Aisha before witr, and she prayed witr too.

bukhari:2704.title: "This son of mine is a sayyid"
bukhari:2704.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said of al-Hasan: "This son of mine is a sayyid"; through him Allah may reconcile two Muslim groups.

bukhari:7280.title: All will enter Paradise
bukhari:7280.summary: The whole Ummah will enter Paradise except those who refuse, and the one who refuses disobeys the Prophet ﷺ.

muslim:1566.title: Pray when you remember
muslim:1566.summary: Whoever forgets a prayer should pray it when he remembers, and that is enough.

muslim:1877.title: Two lights
muslim:1877.summary: An angel gave the Prophet ﷺ glad news of two lights: al-Fatiha and the end of Surah al-Baqarah.

muslim:2715.title: Then I will fast
muslim:2715.summary: Learning there was no food at home, the Prophet ﷺ calmly decided to fast, reproaching no one.

muslim:1836.title: If recitation will not come
muslim:1836.summary: If at night you struggle to recite and do not understand what you say, lie down and sleep.

bukhari:4965.title: The river al-Kawthar
bukhari:4965.summary: Al-Kawthar is a river given to the Prophet ﷺ, with tents of pearl and vessels as many as the stars.

bukhari:5378.title: "In the name of Allah"
bukhari:5378.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught his stepson Umar: say "In the name of Allah" and take what is near you.

bukhari:2351.title: The cup and the youngest
bukhari:2351.summary: The Prophet ﷺ asked the boy on his right if the cup could pass to the elders, and respected his refusal.

bukhari:660.title: Seven in Allah's shade
bukhari:660.summary: Allah will shade seven, among them those who love each other for Him and one who weeps remembering Him alone.

bukhari:6445.title: Not keeping gold
bukhari:6445.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that with gold like Mount Uhud he would give it away in three days, keeping only for debts.

bukhari:2885.title: The Prophet's ﷺ peaceful sleep
bukhari:2885.summary: The Prophet ﷺ wished a righteous man would guard him at night; Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas came, and he slept.

bukhari:609.title: Witnesses of the call
bukhari:609.summary: All that hears the caller to prayer, people, jinn and other creatures, will bear witness for him.

bukhari:765.title: Surah at-Tur at sunset
bukhari:765.summary: Jubayr heard the Prophet ﷺ recite Surah at-Tur in the sunset prayer.

muslim:1823.title: A living house
muslim:1823.summary: A house where Allah is remembered and one where He is not are like the living and the dead.

bukhari:6237.title: Who says salam first
bukhari:6237.summary: A Muslim may not shun his brother over three days; the better of the two is the one who greets first.

bukhari:3922.title: Allah is our third
bukhari:3922.summary: In the cave the Prophet ﷺ calmed Abu Bakr: "What do you think of two whose third is Allah?"

bukhari:247.title: Wudu and the right side
bukhari:247.summary: Before sleep make wudu, lie on your right side and say: "O Allah, I submit to You and entrust my affair to You…"

bukhari:5985.title: Ties of kinship
bukhari:5985.summary: Whoever wants his provision increased and his life prolonged, let him keep ties of kinship.

muslim:1844.title: Keep revising the Quran
muslim:1844.summary: Recite the Quran constantly: it slips from hearts faster than camels from their tethers.

bukhari:847.title: In prayer while you wait
bukhari:847.summary: The Prophet ﷺ told those awaiting isha: "People sleep, but you are in prayer the whole time you wait."

bukhari:4293.title: Praise and forgiveness in bowing
bukhari:4293.summary: In bowing and prostration the Prophet ﷺ said: "Glory be to You, our Lord, and praise; O Allah, forgive me."

bukhari:950.title: Celebrating together
bukhari:950.summary: On Eid the Prophet ﷺ let Aisha watch the Ethiopians' games, cheek to cheek, until she had had enough.

muslim:1700.title: Long night prayer
muslim:1700.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ night prayer was long: he prayed sometimes standing, sometimes sitting.

bukhari:6180.title: Kind words about yourself
bukhari:6180.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught not to say the harsh "I am wicked" of oneself, but to choose gentle words.

bukhari:7443.title: Without an intermediary
bukhari:7443.summary: Allah will speak to each of you Himself, with no interpreter and no barrier.

bukhari:5813.title: His favourite garment
bukhari:5813.summary: The garments the Prophet ﷺ loved most to wear were striped Yemeni cloaks.

bukhari:6581.title: The river al-Kawthar
bukhari:6581.summary: In Paradise the Prophet ﷺ saw the river al-Kawthar, with tents of hollow pearl along its banks.

bukhari:7422.title: Mercy outstrips wrath
bukhari:7422.summary: Having completed creation, Allah wrote above the Throne: "Truly, My mercy outstrips My wrath."

bukhari:1157.title: A fine man
bukhari:1157.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Abdullah is a fine man, if only he prayed at night", and he began praying at night.

bukhari:7204.title: Sincerity to everyone
bukhari:7204.summary: The Prophet ﷺ took Jarir's pledge to be sincere to every Muslim, as far as he was able.

muslim:1862.title: A double reward for the reciter
muslim:1862.summary: A skilled reciter is with the noble angels, and one who recites with difficulty gets a double reward.

bukhari:6424.title: Patience in loss
bukhari:6424.summary: For one who patiently bears the loss of a loved one hoping for reward, Allah has no recompense but Paradise.

bukhari:5228.title: I know when you are pleased
bukhari:5228.summary: The Prophet ﷺ fondly told Aisha he knew from her oath whether she was pleased with him or upset.

bukhari:6147.title: All but Allah is perishing
bukhari:6147.summary: The Prophet ﷺ called Labid's words the truest of poetry: "Everything except Allah is perishing."

bukhari:5010.title: Ayat al-Kursi before sleep
bukhari:5010.summary: Whoever reads Ayat al-Kursi before sleep is guarded by a protector from Allah till morning; the Prophet ﷺ confirmed it.

bukhari:5929.title: He never refused perfume
bukhari:5929.summary: The Prophet ﷺ never turned down perfume given to him.

bukhari:2073.title: Bread of your own hands
bukhari:2073.summary: The prophet Dawud ate only what he earned with his own hands.

bukhari:1130.title: A grateful servant
bukhari:1130.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at night until his feet swelled, saying: "Should I not be a grateful servant?"

bukhari:2066.title: Reward for the wife
bukhari:2066.summary: If a wife gives from her husband's earnings without his express order, she gets half his reward.

bukhari:1425.title: Reward for the whole home
bukhari:1425.summary: If a wife gives food from the home without harm, she, her husband and the keeper are rewarded, none less.

bukhari:1118.title: Night prayer in old age
bukhari:1118.summary: In old age the Prophet ﷺ recited at night sitting, and before bowing stood up and finished standing.

bukhari:7498.title: What no eye has seen
bukhari:7498.summary: Allah has prepared for the righteous what no eye has seen, no ear heard and no heart imagined.

bukhari:3779.title: The valley of the Ansar
bukhari:3779.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that if the Ansar took a valley, he would follow them, for they sheltered and supported him.

bukhari:6475.title: Good words or silence
bukhari:6475.summary: A believer speaks good or stays silent, does not harm his neighbour and honours his guest.

muslim:2492.title: Bless them
muslim:2492.summary: When people brought charity, the Prophet ﷺ prayed for them: "O Allah, bless them."

bukhari:6125.title: Make things easy
bukhari:6125.summary: Make things easy, not hard; bring people joy and do not drive them away.

bukhari:996.title: Witr at any hour of night
bukhari:996.summary: The Prophet ﷺ prayed witr at various hours of the night, from after isha to the last hour.

bukhari:6201.title: Greetings from Jibril
bukhari:6201.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said: "O Aisha, Jibril greets you", and she returned the greeting of peace.

bukhari:3345.title: Is there anyone who will heed?
bukhari:3345.summary: Ibn Mas'ud heard the Prophet ﷺ recite the verse: "Is there anyone who will heed?"

bukhari:864.title: Waiting for the night prayer
bukhari:864.summary: With women and children asleep, the Prophet ﷺ told those waiting that no one on earth but them awaited this prayer.

bukhari:7391.title: Turner of hearts
bukhari:7391.summary: When swearing, the Prophet ﷺ most often said: "By the One who turns hearts!"

bukhari:6484.title: Who is a Muslim
bukhari:6484.summary: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand others are safe; an emigrant is one who leaves the forbidden.

bukhari:6306.title: The master dua of forgiveness
bukhari:6306.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught the master plea for forgiveness: "O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You…"

bukhari:7405.title: As My servant thinks of Me
bukhari:7405.summary: Allah says: "I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me."

bukhari:2363.title: He watered a dog
bukhari:2363.summary: A man gave water to a dog suffering from thirst, and Allah thanked him and forgave him.

bukhari:6003.title: He hugged the children
bukhari:6003.summary: The Prophet ﷺ sat Usama and al-Hasan on his lap, hugged them and asked Allah to have mercy on them.

muslim:6965.title: He forgives those who ask
muslim:6965.summary: If you did not sin, Allah would bring people who sin, ask forgiveness and are forgiven.

bukhari:2705.title: Lenient to a debtor
bukhari:2705.summary: Hearing the Prophet's ﷺ reproach, a man who swore not to ease his debtor at once agreed to be kind.

muslim:1807.title: Two light rak'ahs
muslim:1807.summary: When you rise at night to pray, begin with two light rak'ahs.

muslim:1510.title: Waiting for prayer
muslim:1510.summary: A person is in prayer as long as waiting for the prayer keeps him from going home to his family.

muslim:1852.title: Abu Musa's beautiful voice
muslim:1852.summary: The Prophet ﷺ praised Abu Musa's recitation, saying he had a voice like that of David's family.

bukhari:6953.title: All by intentions
bukhari:6953.summary: Deeds are judged by intentions, and each gets what he aimed for.

bukhari:2122.title: Where is the little one?
bukhari:2122.summary: At Fatimah's house the Prophet ﷺ hugged his grandson who ran out: "O Allah, love him and those who love him!"

bukhari:2796.title: Light of a woman of Paradise
bukhari:2796.summary: If a woman of Paradise appeared to the people of earth, she would light and perfume all between sky and earth.

bukhari:1151.title: As much as you can
bukhari:1151.summary: Do only what you are able to: Allah does not tire until you tire.

muslim:2324.title: Ties with her mother
muslim:2324.summary: Asma asked whether to keep ties with her visiting mother, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "Yes."

bukhari:3822.title: Always with a smile
bukhari:3822.summary: Jarir said the Prophet ﷺ never refused to see him and always smiled when they met.

muslim:2343.title: A date grown like a mountain
muslim:2343.summary: Even a date given from good earnings Allah accepts and grows until it is the size of a mountain.

bukhari:5411.title: The dearest date
bukhari:5411.summary: The Prophet ﷺ handed out seven dates each; dearest to Abu Hurayrah was a hard one he chewed for long.

bukhari:5988.title: Kinship from the Merciful
bukhari:5988.summary: "Rahim" (kinship) comes from the name ar-Rahman; Allah keeps ties with whoever keeps ties of kinship.

bukhari:6293.title: Put out fires before sleep
bukhari:6293.summary: When you go to sleep, do not leave a fire burning in the house.

bukhari:5648.title: Like leaves from a tree
bukhari:5648.summary: Any pain, even a thorn's prick, removes a Muslim's sins as a tree sheds its leaves.

muslim:6578.title: A brother in need
muslim:6578.summary: Whoever helps a brother in need, Allah helps him; whoever relieves a Muslim's grief, Allah relieves his on Judgement Day.

bukhari:6010.title: Vast mercy
bukhari:6010.summary: To a man asking mercy only for himself and the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "You have narrowed what is boundlessly vast."

muslim:1841.title: Keep revising the Quran
muslim:1841.summary: Revise the Quran constantly: it slips from hearts faster than camels from their tethers.

bukhari:6345.title: Dua in distress
bukhari:6345.summary: In distress the Prophet ﷺ said: "No god but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing, Lord of the heavens, earth and great Throne."

muslim:1744.title: If he missed the night prayer
muslim:1744.summary: If the Prophet ﷺ slept through night prayer or was ill, he made it up by day with twelve rak'ahs.

bukhari:7501.title: A good intention is recorded
bukhari:7501.summary: If a servant intends good but does not do it, one good deed is written; if he does it, ten to seven hundred.

bukhari:3149.title: A smile for rudeness
bukhari:3149.summary: When a Bedouin yanked the Prophet's ﷺ cloak demanding money, he laughed and ordered that he be given something.

bukhari:7436.title: Like the full moon
bukhari:7436.summary: On a full-moon night the Prophet ﷺ said: "You will see your Lord on Judgement Day as you see this moon."

bukhari:2029.title: Aisha combed the Prophet's ﷺ hair
bukhari:2029.summary: From the mosque, the Prophet ﷺ would lean his head to Aisha, and she would tend his hair.

bukhari:3583.title: The weeping palm trunk
bukhari:3583.summary: When the Prophet ﷺ moved to the pulpit, the palm trunk wept, and he came and stroked it.

bukhari:1152.title: Do not abandon night prayer
bukhari:1152.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not be like one who prayed at night and then stopped."

muslim:6542.title: Allah looks at hearts
muslim:6542.summary: Allah looks not at your bodies and forms, but at your hearts.

bukhari:7563.title: Two light words
bukhari:7563.summary: Two phrases, beloved to the Merciful, light on the tongue, heavy on the Scales: Subhan-Allahi wa bi-hamdihi, Subhan-Allahi al-Azim.

muslim:4525.title: Ease, do not burden
muslim:4525.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught: "Bring joy and do not repel; make things easy and do not burden."

bukhari:7235.title: Time to repent
bukhari:7235.summary: Do not wish for death: the good may add more good, and the one who slipped may repent.

bukhari:6039.title: He helped at home
bukhari:6039.summary: At home the Prophet ﷺ helped his family with chores, and when prayer time came he went to pray.

bukhari:1124.title: When there is no strength
bukhari:1124.summary: Once the Prophet ﷺ fell ill and did not rise for the night prayer for a night or two.

bukhari:5304.title: Beside the orphan's guardian
bukhari:5304.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that in Paradise he and the guardian of an orphan will be as close as two adjacent fingers.

bukhari:6234.title: Who greets first
bukhari:6234.summary: The younger greets the elder first, the walker the one sitting, the smaller group the larger.

bukhari:517.title: A bed beside his prayer place
bukhari:517.summary: Maymuna said her bed faced the Prophet's ﷺ place of prayer, and his garment sometimes touched her.

bukhari:5016.title: Surahs of healing
bukhari:5016.summary: When ill, the Prophet ﷺ recited the protecting surahs over himself, and Aisha recited them, wiping him with his hand.

bukhari:4896.title: Five names of the Prophet ﷺ
bukhari:4896.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said he has five names: Muhammad, Ahmad, al-Mahi, al-Hashir and al-Aqib.

bukhari:6320.title: Dust off your bed
bukhari:6320.summary: Lying down, dust off your bed with your garment's edge and say: "In Your name, my Lord, I lie down and rise…"

bukhari:672.title: Supper first
bukhari:672.summary: If supper is served, eat it before the sunset prayer, and do not rush your meal.

muslim:1524.title: Hospitality in Paradise
muslim:1524.summary: For whoever goes to the mosque early and late in the day, Allah prepares a welcome in Paradise each time.

bukhari:5419.title: Aisha's excellence
bukhari:5419.summary: Aisha's excellence over other women is like that of tharid over other food.

bukhari:3109.title: The mended bowl
bukhari:3109.summary: When the Prophet's ﷺ bowl cracked, he fastened it with a silver chain.

bukhari:2707.title: Justice is charity
bukhari:2707.summary: Each joint of a person owes charity every day, and judging fairly between people is charity too.

muslim:1753.title: Witr before dawn
muslim:1753.summary: Hasten to pray witr before morning comes.

bukhari:3369.title: Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
bukhari:3369.summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught: "O Allah, bless Muhammad, his wives and offspring, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim."

bukhari:2472.title: A branch off the road
bukhari:2472.summary: A man removed a thorny branch from the road, and Allah thanked him by forgiving his sins.

bukhari:6203.title: What did the little bird do?
bukhari:6203.summary: The Prophet ﷺ fondly asked little Abu Umayr about his bird and prayed at their home.

bukhari:5038.title: Quran recited at night
bukhari:5038.summary: Hearing the Quran at night, the Prophet ﷺ said: "May Allah have mercy on him! He reminded me of verses I forgot."

bukhari:7509.title: Faith like a mustard seed
bukhari:7509.summary: The Prophet ﷺ will ask that even those with a mustard seed of faith in their hearts enter Paradise.

bukhari:5009.title: Two verses before sleep
bukhari:5009.summary: Whoever recites the last two verses of al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.

bukhari:6198.title: A name for a newborn
bukhari:6198.summary: Abu Musa brought his newborn son to the Prophet ﷺ, who named him Ibrahim and prayed for blessing.

bukhari:6289.title: He kept the secret
bukhari:6289.summary: Anas kept a secret the Prophet ﷺ entrusted to him and did not reveal it even to his mother.

muslim:4481.title: Hold together
muslim:4481.summary: Allah wants you to worship Him alone and hold together, and dislikes gossip, needless questions and waste.

bukhari:2627.title: Nothing to fear
bukhari:2627.summary: When alarm gripped Medina, the Prophet ﷺ rode out himself to check and returned: "We saw nothing to fear."

bukhari:1388.title: Charity for a mother
bukhari:1388.summary: The Prophet ﷺ confirmed that a son's charity for his late mother would bring her reward.

bukhari:6985.title: A good dream
bukhari:6985.summary: A pleasant dream is from Allah: praise Him for it; from an unpleasant one seek Allah's refuge, and it will not harm.

muslim:2083.title: Rain from the Lord
muslim:2083.summary: The Prophet ﷺ exposed himself to the rain, saying it had just come from his Lord.

bukhari:6543.title: Faces like the full moon
bukhari:6543.summary: Seventy thousand of the Ummah will enter Paradise with faces like the moon on the night it is full.

muslim:6963.title: He loves to forgive
muslim:6963.summary: If people did not sin, Allah would create those who sin, in order to forgive them.

muslim:6052.title: Tenderness to children
muslim:6052.summary: On his way home the Prophet ﷺ stroked children's cheeks, and his hands gave off a scent of perfume.

muslim:1696.title: A house in Paradise
muslim:1696.summary: Whoever prays twelve voluntary rak'ahs daily for Allah will have a house built in Paradise.

bukhari:1145.title: The last third of the night
bukhari:1145.summary: In the last third of the night the Lord descends to the lowest heaven: "Who asks, I give; who seeks forgiveness, I forgive."

bukhari:628.title: Go back to your families
bukhari:628.summary: Seeing his guests missed their families, the Prophet ﷺ gently sent them home to teach their families and pray.

bukhari:6225.title: Praise after sneezing
bukhari:6225.summary: The Prophet ﷺ replied "May Allah have mercy on you" to the one who praised Allah after sneezing.

bukhari:5031.title: Guard what you learn
bukhari:5031.summary: One who knows the Quran by heart is like an owner of tethered camels: hold them and they stay, let go and they run.

bukhari:7466.title: A supple shoot
bukhari:7466.summary: A believer is like a young shoot: the wind of trials bends it, and when it calms, it straightens up.

bukhari:5998.title: Kissing a child
bukhari:5998.summary: A Bedouin wondered at kissing children; the Prophet ﷺ said: "What can I do if Allah has taken mercy from your heart?"

muslim:1094.title: A companion in Paradise
muslim:1094.summary: Rabi'a asked to be the Prophet's ﷺ companion in Paradise; he said: "Help me with it by many prostrations."

bukhari:666.title: Pray where you are
bukhari:666.summary: On cold, rainy nights the Prophet ﷺ had the muezzin announce: "Pray in your dwellings."

muslim:1067.title: Praise filling the heavens
muslim:1067.summary: Rising from bowing, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Our Lord, to You be praise filling the heavens and the earth."

bukhari:6456.title: The Prophet's ﷺ bed
bukhari:6456.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ bed was of leather stuffed with palm fibre.

bukhari:1141.title: His nights
bukhari:1141.summary: Whoever wished to see the Prophet ﷺ praying at night saw him praying, and whoever wished to see him asleep saw him asleep.

bukhari:5744.title: Dua for healing
bukhari:5744.summary: "Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind: healing is in Your hand, and none but You can remove it."

bukhari:7395.title: Lying down: "In Your name"
bukhari:7395.summary: Going to bed, the Prophet ﷺ said: "In Your name we die and live", and on waking praised Allah.

bukhari:5599.title: He loved sweets
bukhari:5599.summary: Aisha said the Prophet ﷺ loved sweets and honey.

bukhari:3362.title: The mother of Ismail
bukhari:3362.summary: May Allah have mercy on Ismail's mother: had she not hurried to collect the water, Zamzam would be a flowing spring.

muslim:2328.title: Every good deed is sadaqah
muslim:2328.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said every good and approved deed is charity.

bukhari:6887.title: Last, yet first
bukhari:6887.summary: We are the last community, but on the Day of Resurrection we will be first.

bukhari:14.title: Love for the Prophet ﷺ
bukhari:14.summary: None of you believes until he loves the Prophet ﷺ more than his father and children.

muslim:2756.title: Prayer in the depth of night
muslim:2756.summary: The best prayer after the obligatory one is prayer in the depth of the night.

bukhari:3443.title: The prophets are brothers
bukhari:3443.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said he is closest of all to Isa, son of Maryam, and the prophets are brothers of one religion.

bukhari:6017.title: A gift to a neighbour
bukhari:6017.summary: Let no neighbour belittle a gift to her neighbour, even if just a sheep's hoof.

bukhari:1896.title: The gate of ar-Rayyan
bukhari:1896.summary: Paradise has a gate, ar-Rayyan, through which only those who fasted will enter.

bukhari:7546.title: The most beautiful voice
bukhari:7546.summary: In the isha prayer the Prophet ﷺ recited "By the fig and the olive", and no voice or recitation was more beautiful.

bukhari:95.title: He repeated it three times
bukhari:95.summary: The Prophet ﷺ repeated his words three times to be understood, and greeted people three times on arriving.

bukhari:5236.title: Festive games
bukhari:5236.summary: The Prophet ﷺ screened Aisha with his cloak as she watched the Ethiopians' games as long as she wished.
